jobs.title: Logistics Supervisor – Data Centre Projects
jobs.description:
The right material, in the right place, at the right time.

Fortica builds and finishes data centres across Norway and the Nordics. As Logistics Supervisor you make sure materials, equipment and plant reach the site at the right time, in the right place and in good condition, safely and without holding up the work. This includes heavy and sensitive data centre equipment such as generators, transformers, switchgear, UPS units, chillers and server racks.

What you will do

  • Run the delivery schedule and the booking system for delivery slots, in line with the 2–6 week look-ahead plan

  • Plan oversized deliveries (routes, permits and escorts) and track long-lead equipment (items that take months to deliver)

  • Manage laydown areas (storage zones on site), unloading zones, site roads and the site store

  • Receive deliveries: check quantity, condition and paperwork, and report any damage

  • Coordinate cranes, forklifts and telehandlers, and take part in lift planning and risk assessments

  • Coordinate daily with subcontractors, suppliers and hauliers

  • Make sure safety (HSE) rules are followed and logistics areas are kept clean and tidy

  • Send a weekly logistics report and check logistics costs before invoices are approved

  • Lead a small team of delivery coordinators, storekeepers, plant operators and banksmen (signallers who guide lifts and vehicles)

Who you are

  • Hands-on experience with heavy lifting and site logistics on large construction projects

  • Experience leading a logistics or warehouse team

  • Structured, and good at planning ahead

  • Comfortable with Excel or similar planning tools

  • Good English, spoken and written

  • Driving licence class B

  • Lifting or forklift certificates (for example truckførerbevis) are a plus

What makes you a good fit

You plan ahead and keep control when there is a lot of time pressure. You stand firm on safety and stop unsafe lifts or deliveries. You communicate clearly and solve conflicts between subcontractors before they grow.

What we offer

  • 3:1 rotation (3 weeks on, 1 week off) with flights, accommodation and meals covered

  • 4 % pension and health insurance

  • We help you get your HMS card (the Norwegian ID card for everyone working on a construction site) if you do not have one

  • Real responsibility on large, modern projects

  • A safe workplace with fair terms and a written employment contract

  • Part of CTS Group, one of Europe's leading data centre design and build groups

You report to: Site Manager / Project ManagerLocation: Fyresdal, Norway

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We believe that through the right systems, talent and tools, it is possible to build better products, more quickly, at a lower cost.

We build with purpose – combining innovation, sustainability and openness to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions, while empowering people to think boldly, act responsibly and grow together.

jobs.title: Machinist, Bluefors Oy
jobs.description: Bluefors Oy is a Finnish high-tech company based in Helsinki, working at the absolute frontier of quantum technology. They design and manufacture some of the world's most precise cryogenic measurement systems - the kind of equipment that pushes the boundaries of what science can do. When you work here, your machining skills directly support cutting-edge research used by leading institutions and companies around the world.As a Machinist at Bluefors, you'll be working with a 5-axis DMG Mori milling machine, producing precision parts from materials like copper, aluminium, brass, stainless steel, and POM. The work is varied - small series, tight tolerances where it counts, and surface finishes that matter. You'll have real influence over your work, not just push a button and repeat.YOUR TASKSYou'll be working as a Machinist in Bluefors' production team, operating a 5-axis DMG Mori milling machine to manufacture precision components for quantum technology systems.- Setting up and operating 5-axis DMG Mori milling machines using Heidenhain controls- Machining parts from copper, AISI 316 stainless steel, brass, aluminium, and POM- Working with part sizes ranging from 5 to 360 mm in diameter- Producing small series (typically under 10 pieces) with accuracy and consistency- Maintaining tight tolerances and high surface quality standards where required- Reading and interpreting technical drawings and machining programs- Carrying out quality checks and ensuring finished parts meet specifications- Contributing to a clean, organized, and safe workshop environmentREQUIREMENTS- Solid experience setting up and operating CNC milling machines- Hands-on experience with 5-axis machining- Familiarity with Heidenhain controls- Ability to read technical drawings and apply tolerances accurately- Attention to surface quality and detail- Good communication skills in Finnish or EnglishNICE TO HAVE- Experience with Mastercam or other CAM software- Background machining copper, brass, or other non-ferrous materials- Experience in small-series precision manufacturing- Prior work in a high-tech or engineering environmentChosen applicants will initially be employed by Barona Teollisuus Oy on a fixed-term 6-month contract, with the possibility of extension.This is full-time position from Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week with 2-shift rotation on a 3-week cycle: 2 weeks on a day shift (Monday to Friday) and 1 week on evening shift (Monday to Thursday from 14.00 to 00.00, Fridays off).If this sounds like you and you're the machinist were looking for, submit your application today using the link provided. For more information, contact Ari Kumlander at Barona by email at ari.kumlander@barona.fi. Please note that, due to data privacy regulations, we cannot accept applications submitted via email.

jobs.title: Rogerz søger butikschef til Danmarks førende trading card game butik (Odense)
jobs.description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for åbningen af Rogerz' første butik på Fyn?

Rogerz fortsætter vores vækstrejse, og i første kvartal af 2027 åbner vi dørene til vores nye butik i Odense!

Derfor søger vi en erfaren, ambitiøs og engageret Butikschef, som får en helt central rolle i etableringen og den efterfølgende drift af vores nye butik.

Vi leder efter en stærk retailprofil, der motiveres af mennesker, ledelse og resultater, og som har lyst til at være med til at opbygge en butik og et team fra bunden.

Hvem er Rogerz?

Rogerz er en af Nordens hurtigst voksende virksomheder inden for TCG, sportskort og samleobjekter.

Vi specialiserer os i samlekort, tilbehør og collectibles fra blandt andet Pokémon, One Piece, Topps, Disney, Star Wars, Magic: The Gathering, Riftbound og mange flere.

Vi er selv samlere og entusiaster helt ind til benet, og passionen for produkterne og miljøet er en stor del af vores kultur.

Af samlere, for samlere.

Med butikker i Field's, Rødovre Centrum og Lyngby Storcenter fortsætter vi nu vores ekspansion med en ny butik i Odense.

Ambitionen er at skabe en butik, der bliver et naturligt samlingspunkt for både nye og erfarne samlere på Fyn, hvor produktviden, fællesskab og en ekstraordinær kundeoplevelse går hånd i hånd.

Din rolle som Store Manager

Som Store Manager får du det overordnede ansvar for butikkens medarbejdere, daglige drift og kommercielle resultater.

Men denne stilling er noget særligt.

Du får nemlig mulighed for at være med helt fra begyndelsen og spille en afgørende rolle i etableringen af vores nye butik.

I perioden op til åbningen vil du i tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens ledelse være med til at opbygge dit team, implementere vores standarder og procedurer og sikre, at butikken er klar til at levere en fantastisk kundeoplevelse fra første åbningsdag.

Efter åbningen bliver det dit ansvar at sikre en veldrevet, lønsom og succesfuld butik med et stærkt team, der hver dag leverer på Rogerz' ambitioner.

Dine primære ansvarsområder bliver blandt andet:

  • Deltage aktivt i etableringen og klargøringen af vores nye butik i Odense.

  • Rekruttere, onboarde og udvikle dit eget butiksteam.

  • Sikre en succesfuld butiksåbning og skabe et stærkt fundament for den fremtidige drift.

  • Varetage den daglige ledelse og drift af butikken med det fulde personaleansvar.

  • Udarbejde og løbende optimere vagtplaner med fokus på bemanding, produktivitet og lønomkostninger.

  • Træne, coache og udvikle medarbejderne inden for salg, kundeservice og produktviden.

  • Sikre en høj, professionel og ensartet kundeoplevelse i overensstemmelse med Rogerz' standarder.

  • Arbejde struktureret med butikkens KPI'er, omsætning, salgsmål og øvrige resultater.

  • Sikre overholdelse af butikkens løn-, bemandings- og driftsbudgetter.

  • Arbejde målrettet med salgsudvikling, mersalg og kommercielle initiativer.

  • Sikre, at virksomhedens procedurer, sikkerhedsstandarder og retningslinjer efterleves.

  • Bidrage aktivt til udviklingen af nye initiativer, events og koncepter i samarbejde med virksomhedens ledelse.

Kort sagt får du ansvaret for at bygge en butik op fra bunden, skabe et stærkt og motiveret team og sikre, at Rogerz får den bedst mulige start i Odense.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har solid erfaring fra retail, gerne fra en lignende lederstilling, hvor du har haft ansvar for både medarbejdere, drift og kommercielle resultater.

Du er en leder, der trives med ansvar, arbejder struktureret og formår at skabe resultater gennem dine medarbejdere.

Du ved, at en succesfuld butik kræver mere end gode salgstal. Det kræver stærk ledelse, tydelige forventninger, engagerede medarbejdere og en kundeoplevelse, der giver kunderne lyst til at komme igen.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • Har dokumenteret erfaring med personaleledelse inden for retail.

  • Har erfaring med rekruttering, onboarding og udvikling af medarbejdere.

  • Har stærke kompetencer inden for vagtplanlægning, bemandingsoptimering og omkostningsstyring.

  • Er vant til at arbejde målrettet med KPI'er, salgstal, budgetter og performance.

  • Har en kommerciel tankegang og evner at omsætte analyser og resultater til konkrete handlinger.

  • Er en synlig, nærværende og motiverende leder, som går forrest på butiksgulvet.

  • Arbejder struktureret og kan skabe overblik i en travl og omskiftelig hverdag.

  • Har et højt ambitionsniveau og tager ejerskab for både dine medarbejderes udvikling og butikkens resultater.

  • Er selvstændig, løsningsorienteret og god til at følge dine initiativer helt til dørs.

  • Trives i en virksomhed i vækst, hvor udvikling og forandringer er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du tidligere har været involveret i åbningen af en ny butik eller har erfaring med at opbygge og udvikle et nyt team.

Kendskab til TCG og collectibles er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Du behøver ikke kende forskellen på en Pokémon Booster Box og en Topps Hobby Box, når du starter.

Til gengæld forventer vi, at du er nysgerrig, lærevillig og har lyst til at sætte dig grundigt ind i produkterne og det univers, som vores kunder og medarbejdere brænder for.

For os er det vigtigere at finde den rette leder med de rette kompetencer og værdier end en erfaren samler uden ledelseserfaring.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos Rogerz bliver du en del af en ambitiøs virksomhed i kraftig vækst, hvor du får reel mulighed for at sætte dit præg på både din egen butik og udviklingen af vores retail-organisation.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • En spændende lederstilling med det samlede ansvar for vores nye butik i Odense.

  • En unik mulighed for at være med til at etablere en helt ny butik og opbygge dit eget team.

  • Stor indflydelse på butikkens daglige drift, udvikling og kommercielle resultater.

  • Et tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens øverste ledelse og ejerkreds.

  • Korte beslutningsveje og mulighed for hurtigt at omsætte idéer til handling.

  • En arbejdsplads med stærkt fællesskab, høj energi og en fælles passion for vores produkter.

  • Mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling i takt med virksomhedens fortsatte vækst.

  • Et arbejdsmiljø, hvor initiativ, ansvarlighed og gode resultater bliver værdsat.

Vi tror på, at dygtige ledere skaber dygtige medarbejdere, og at engagerede medarbejdere skaber de bedste kundeoplevelser.

Derfor får du både ansvar, tillid og mulighed for at udvikle dig som leder hos os.

Praktiske oplysninger

Stilling: Store Manager / Butikschef

Arbejdssted: Rogerz, Odense

Arbejdstid: Fuldtid, 37 timer om ugen

Forventet butiks åbning: Q1 2027

Tiltrædelse: Efter nærmere aftale, med mulighed for opstart inden butikkens åbning.

Løn: Efter kvalifikationer og nærmere aftale.

Da vi arbejder inden for retail, vil aften- og weekendvagter være en naturlig del af jobbet.

Vi forventer, at vores kommende Store Manager bliver en aktiv del af forberedelserne frem mod åbningen, herunder rekruttering, oplæring og klargøring af butikken.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Head of Retail, Michael Kokholm Larsen på telefon 21 77 84 77.

jobs.description:
Vil du være med på å skape gode opplevelser for våre gjester?

Sanner Hotell søker en serviceinnstilt og engasjert servitør til vårt team. Hos oss får du en variert arbeidshverdag med servering på konferanser, bryllup, julebord, selskaper og i restaurant. Vi ser etter deg som trives med mennesker, liker høyt tempo og motiveres av å levere service av høy kvalitet.

Hva vi ser etter

  • Har minimum ett års erfaring fra restaurant, servering, bar eller bartenderarbeid

  • Er fylt 20 år

  • Har interesse for mat, drikke og gode gjesteopplevelser

  • Har førerkort klasse B og disponerer egen bil

  • Snakker et skandinavisk språk eller flytende engelsk

  • Trives med mennesker og yter god service

  • Arbeider godt i et miljø med høyt tempo

  • Er pålitelig, positiv og bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø

Arbeidsoppgaver Hva skal du gjøre?

Som servitør hos Sanner Hotell blir du en viktig del av teamet som skaper gode opplevelser for våre gjester. Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet bestå av:

  • Oppdekking og klargjøring før arrangementer

  • Servering av mat og drikke

  • Servering ved konferanser, bryllup, julebord og selskaper

  • Rydding og klargjøring av restaurant- og selskapslokaler

  • Gjesteservice og oppfølging av våre gjester

  • Bidra til at arrangementer gjennomføres på en profesjonell og smidig måte

  • Samarbeide med kollegaer for å sikre høy kvalitet i alle ledd

  • Bidra der det trengs i en hektisk og variert arbeidshverdag

Vi tilbyr

  • Konkurransedyktige lønns- og arbeidsvilkår

  • Lønn etter tariff og gjeldende avtaler

  • God opplæring og oppfølging

  • En arbeidsplass med høy aktivitet og varierte arbeidsdager

  • Et profesjonelt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

  • Gode muligheter for faglig utvikling

  • Mulighet for flere vakter i travle perioder

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sanner Hotell er et familiedrevet hotell med lange tradisjoner, idyllisk beliggende på Granavollen på Hadeland. Vi er kjent for vår personlige service, hyggelige atmosfære og gode matopplevelser.

Gjennom hele året ønsker vi gjester velkommen til konferanser, kurs, bryllup, julebord, selskaper og hotellopphold. Som en del av vårt serveringsteam blir du med på å skape gode opplevelser for våre gjester hver eneste dag.

jobs.title: Bordenbouwer/ Kastenbouwer
jobs.description:
Wat wordt erVan jou verwacht?

  • Bouwen en bekabelen van elektrische stuur- en regelkasten aan de hand van elektrische schema's.
  • Monteren, aansluiten en correct nummeren van elektrische componenten en bekabeling.
  • Controleren of elke kast technisch correct en netjes afgewerkt is.
  • Ombouwen en aanpassen van bestaande elektrische kasten.
  • Meewerken aan zowel kleinere opdrachten als grotere technische projecten.
  • Technische problemen of afwijkingen opmerken en meedenken over een oplossing.
  • Af en toe werkzaamheden uitvoeren bij klanten of op locatie.
  • Samenwerken met collega's aan installaties binnen HVAC, regeltechniek en gebouwautomatisatie.

Je werkt voornamelijk in het atelier, maar afwisseling is verzekerd. De ene keer bouw je een volledig nieuwe regelkast, de andere keer pas je een bestaande installatie aan of ga je mee naar een klant.

Dit is dé perfectejob voor jou...

  • Ervaring met bordenbouw, kastenbouw of industriële elektriciteit.
  • Elektrische schema's lezen en begrijpen vormt geen probleem.
  • Technisch inzicht en een nauwkeurige manier van werken.
  • Interesse in regeltechniek, HVAC en gebouwautomatisatie.
  • Bereidheid om af en toe mee naar klanten of werven te gaan.
  • Flexibele ingesteldheid en zin om verschillende technische uitdagingen aan te pakken.
  • Nederlands spreken en begrijpen.

Een specifiek diploma is minder belangrijk dan technische kennis en praktijkervaring.

Heb je vandaag vooral ervaring met kleinere elektrische kasten en wil je doorgroeien naar complexere installaties? Ook dan is dit een interessante volgende stap.

Er is ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen richting EPLAN, engineering of programmatie. Interne begeleiding en opleiding zorgen ervoor dat je technische kennis steeds verder kan groeien.

jobs.title: Tiltaksstilling, barneverntjenesten
jobs.description:
Vil du bruke din barnevernfaglige kompetanse til å gjøre en forskjell – på tvers av kommuner?

Fjellregionen søker en medarbeider i en inntil ettårig 100 % prosjektstillingstilling som ønsker å bidra til utvikling av barnevernstjenestene og bedre oppfølging av barn, unge og familier.

Fjellregionen består av  barneverntjenestene i Midtre Gauldal, Røros/Holtålen/Os og Oppdal/Rennebu. Arbeidsgiver er Midtre Gauldal kommune.

Vi står overfor flere spennende og krevende faglige oppgaver innen barnevernsfeltet. Nå ønsker vi å styrke kapasiteten og kompetansen i tjenestene gjennom en tiltaksstilling som kan arbeide på tvers av kommunene og bidra der behovene er størst.

Om tiltaksstillingen

Stillingen skal bidra til å styrke tiltakskjeden i barnevernstjenestene i Fjellregionen. Arbeidet vil blant annet omfatte:

  • veiledning og faglig støtte til ansatte og kontaktpersoner i barneverntjenestene
  • oppfølging og veiledning av fosterforeldre utover det som kan ivaretas gjennom ordinære oppfølgingsbesøk
  • arbeid med saker som omhandler vold/rus mellom barn og foreldre
  • bistand i saker med store konflikter mellom foreldre som bor sammen
  • oppfølging av konfliktfylte familiesituasjoner der foreldrene ikke bor sammen
  • arbeid i grenseflaten mellom barnevern og familievern
  • utvikling og utprøving av nye arbeidsformer og tiltak, blant annet elementer fra Omsorgspakken
  • bidra til kompetanse- og erfaringsdeling på tvers av tjenestene i Fjellregionen

Stillingen er tenkt som en fleksibel tiltaksressurs på tvers av tjenestene, og skal ikke samtidig være kontaktperson/saksbehandler i barnevernet. Dette gir mulighet til å arbeide mer målrettet med fagutvikling,veiledning og komplekse problemstillinger i tett samarbeid med aktuelle familier. Det må påregnes  ettermiddags- og kveldsarbeid.

 

Vi ser etter deg som

  • har relevant 3-årig høgskole-/universitetsutdanning
  • har erfaring fra barnevern, familiearbeid eller annet relevant arbeid med barn, unge og familier
  • har god faglig forståelse og interesse for barnevernsfeltet
  • har erfaring med veiledning og relasjonsarbeid
  • gjerne har kompetanse innen arbeid med vold, høykonfliktfamilier eller fosterhjem
  • kan arbeide selvstendig og strukturert
  • har gode samarbeidsevner og evne til å skape tillit
  • er opptatt av faglig utvikling og kunnskapsdeling
  • trives med å arbeide på tvers av kommuner og tjenester
  • Har førerkort for bil og er komfertabel med trønderske veier i alle årstider

Det vil bli lagt stor vekt på personlig egnethet, relevant erfaring og evne til å bidra positivt til fagmiljøene i regionen.

En stilling med mulighet til å gjøre en forskjell

Fjellregionen består av tjenester som møter komplekse og varierte problemstillinger. Samtidig kan det være krevende å rekruttere og beholde fagutdannede medarbeidere til smale og tidsavgrensede arbeidsoppgaver.

Denne stillingen er derfor utformet med tanke på å kunne dekke flere faglige behov for tiltak innen barnevernstjenestene. Vi ønsker å skape en arbeidsplass der du får brukt kompetansen din bredt, samtidig som du får mulighet til å utvikle deg faglig.

En viktig del av arbeidet vil være å sikre erfarings- og kunnskapsdeling mellom ansatte og kontaktpersoner i tjenestene. Det vil blant annet legges opp til felles erfaringsdager, både fysisk og digitalt.

Vi tilbyr

  • 100 % prosjektstilling i inntil ett år, med avslutning av prosjektet innen 31.12.2027, med mindre tjenenesten får tilskudd til å videreføre stillingen.
  • en spennende og variert arbeidshverdag
  • mulighet til å arbeide på tvers av kommuner og fagmiljøer
  • gode muligheter for faglig utvikling og kompetansebygging

jobs.title: Junior International Sales & Business Development Representative – DACH Market
jobs.description:
Empowering organizations in IT risk management

Securance helps organizations build resilience and security, enabling them to provide assurance to stakeholders on IT risk management and cybersecurity. Based in Utrecht, the team works to structurally improve security for clients operating in the DACH market.

Your responsibilitiesJunior International Sales & Partnership Representative – DACH Market

Full-time Graduate Position / Part-time Working Student

📍 Utrecht, The Netherlands
🌍 International Sales & Marketing Team
🇩🇪 DACH Market – Germany, Austria & Switzerland

Your market is DACH. Your team is international. Your career starts in Utrecht.

Are you a German-speaking student or recent graduate looking for an exciting start to your international career?

Would you like to work with colleagues from different countries, build business relationships, visit industry events and learn what professional B2B sales and partnership management are really about?

Welcome to Securance!

We are looking for an enthusiastic Junior International Sales & Partnership Representative to join our international Sales & Marketing team in Utrecht, the Netherlands.

Whether you're finishing your studies or have recently graduated, we offer you the opportunity to develop your commercial skills, build an international network and gain hands-on experience in business development.

One team. Many nationalities. Different markets.

At Securance, international collaboration isn't just something we talk about. It's how we work every day.

Our sales team brings together colleagues from different countries and cultural backgrounds. Each team member focuses on developing business in their own home market, combining local knowledge and language skills with the strength of an international organization.

We work side by side in Utrecht, sharing experiences, exchanging ideas and supporting each other.

As our German-speaking representative, you'll focus on developing our business and partnerships across the DACH region.

You'll also work closely with our colleagues in Germany, travelling there regularly when needed to collaborate with the local team, meet partners, attend events and support commercial opportunities.

Your home base is Utrecht, but your professional network will extend across borders.

Learn Consultative Sales and Partnership Management from experienced professionals

At Securance, we believe successful business development starts with understanding people, their organizations and their challenges.

We don't focus on simply pushing products or closing quick deals. Instead, we practice Consultative Sales: asking the right questions, understanding customer needs, identifying opportunities and developing solutions that create long-term value.

You'll also learn how to build and manage strategic business partnerships, develop professional networks and turn relationships into meaningful commercial opportunities.

Our experienced and innovative team will coach you, involve you in real business activities and help you develop your own professional approach.

We don't expect you to know everything when you join. We expect you to be curious, motivated and eager to learn.

Our ambition is to help you become genuinely good at professional B2B sales, business development and partnership management.

What will you be doing?

As part of our international team, you will:

  • Business Development: Identify potential customers, new business opportunities and commercial prospects in the DACH region.

  • Consultative Sales: Connect with decision-makers, understand their challenges and learn how to develop valuable business solutions.

  • Partnership Management: Help build, develop and maintain relationships with business partners, referral partners and other relevant organizations.

  • Events & Networking: Attend industry conferences, networking events, trade fairs and business meetings to represent Securance and expand our professional network.

  • International Collaboration: Work closely with your international colleagues in Utrecht and regularly visit Germany to collaborate with the German team when needed.

  • Relationship Management: Support the development of long-term relationships with customers and partners.

  • Sales & Marketing: Contribute to commercial campaigns, market research, lead generation and international business development initiatives.

  • Market Development: Gradually take greater ownership of commercial activities and partnership opportunities in your market.

From day one, you'll be involved in real business activities, supported by experienced colleagues.

Who are we looking for?

We're looking for someone with potential, personality and a strong willingness to learn.

You:

  • Are in the final year of your studies or have recently graduated.

  • Speak German at native or near-native level and understand the German-speaking business environment.

  • Have good English communication skills, as English is our international working language.

  • Live in the Netherlands or are willing to relocate to the Utrecht area.

  • Enjoy meeting people, networking and building professional relationships.

  • Are curious, proactive, enthusiastic and commercially minded.

  • Enjoy working with colleagues from different nationalities and cultures.

  • Are interested in B2B sales, business development and partnership management.

  • Are comfortable attending business events and travelling to Germany regularly when required.

Previous sales experience is not required. Your attitude, motivation and willingness to learn matter much more.

What can you expect from Securance?

A genuinely international workplace

Work alongside colleagues from different countries, each bringing their own perspectives, experience and market knowledge.

Excellent professional development

Receive practical training, personal coaching and guidance from experienced sales and business development professionals.

International exposure and travel

Visit Germany to collaborate with local colleagues, meet partners and customers, and attend relevant industry events.

Build your professional network

Develop relationships with companies, industry professionals and business partners across the DACH region.

Real responsibility

Contribute to developing your own market, commercial relationships and partnership opportunities.

An innovative professional environment

Learn about cybersecurity, risk management, IT assurance and related professional services.

Opportunities for students and graduates

We welcome recent graduates interested in a full-time position and final-year students looking to combine their studies with meaningful part-time work.

A collaborative team culture

Become part of a team that shares knowledge, celebrates success and helps each other grow.

About Securance

Securance is an international professional services organization specializing in cybersecurity, risk management, IT assurance and related advisory services.

We help organizations understand risks, strengthen controls and build confidence in their business and technology environments.

Our international approach combines professional expertise with local market understanding, strategic partnerships and long-term customer relationships.

As part of our commercial team, you'll learn how to translate complex business challenges into valuable conversations, business opportunities and sustainable partnerships.

Ready to start your international career?

If you're German-speaking, internationally minded and excited to develop your skills in sales, business development and partnership management, we'd love to meet you.

Join our international team in Utrecht. Build relationships across borders. Start your career with Securance.

Apply now!

Location: Utrecht, The Netherlands. This is an office-based international team position, involving regular business travel to Germany when required. It is not a remote position based in Germany.

jobs.title: Senior global project manager
jobs.description: Reference: 26|HQ|SRM01Location: Geneva, with occasional travelsLine management: Reports to the Head of Global ProgrammesContract duration: Open ended contractStart date: ASAPFUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIESThe Global Project Manager's responsibilities will be delivered under the supervision of the Head of Global Programmes and in close collaboration with all SLT members, HQ departments and country teams, particularly the Head of PPS. The role serves as a key programme management focal point across complex global programmes, supporting effective coordination, decision-making and follow-up across multiple stakeholders and functions. They will include:1. PROJECT COORDINATION AND DONOR REPORTINGOversee the implementation of assigned global projects and ensure progress against approved activities, deliverables, indicators, budgets and contractual commitments, building from existing tracking tools implemented by PPS and Finance teams where relevant.Develop and maintain detailed project-level workplans that can be shared with all project stakeholders to increase visibility on project ambitions, timelines and status.Coordinate project kick off meetings and regular project progress and quality reviews with Global Programmes Managers, country teams, partners and relevant HQ departments;Maintain oversight of contractually required deliverables and reporting deadlines across assigned grants and coordinate/consolidate high-quality narrative reporting to institutional donors, including inputs from country teams, partners and relevant HQ departments;In close coordination with the Project and Partnership Support (PPS) and Finance teams, coordinate donor queries and contractual modifications, including amendments, budget revisions and no-cost extensions, as required;2. RISK IDENTIFICATION AND MANAGEMENTIdentify implementation delays, bottlenecks and risks, and support relevant teams in defining and following up on corrective measures;In the case of major risks that can have organizational implications or require cross-department engagement, ensure, via the Head of Global Programmes, that the Executive Team and the Senior Leadership Team are informed and enabled to take action.When required, liaise with Finance and PPS teams to initiate possible contractual realignment;Ensure that implementation challenges, lessons learned and associated mitigation measures are appropriately documented and leveraged in subsequent phases of the project.3. POOLED FUND MANAGEMENTIn collaboration with the Head of Global Programmes and the Head of PPS, support the coordination internal pooled funding and allocation mechanisms, from the preparation of allocation processes through tracking of activity progress and deliverables;Coordinate the review and follow-up of allocations, ensuring processes are appropriately documented and aligned with project objectives and donor requirements;Monitor implementation, deliverables and reporting across recipient countries and maintain a consolidated overview of progress;Liaise with the Projects and Partnership support team Finance Department to ensure organizational visibility around implementation delays, under-spending and other risks and facilitate corrective action, reprogramming or reallocation where required.4. jobs.title: Senior Analog/Mixed-Signal IC Design Specialist
jobs.description: EinleitungstextThe Microelectronics Design Center (DZ) of the Department of Information Technologies and Electrical Engineering (D-ITET) is a technical support group providing design tools, know-how and licenses for ASIC, FPGA, Embedded Systems and PCB design for research and teaching . This includes consulting, project planning, reviewing of active projects as well as participation in projects. To lead the area of Analog/Mixed-Signal IC Design we are seeking a Senior Analog/Mixed-Signal IC Design Specialist starting 1st of January 2027 or by mutual agreement.Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungYou will be part of an experienced team and be the expert for analog/mixed-signal in the DZ.You will own the analog/mixed-signal area of the IC design infrastructure and further develop it with the aim to provide support to researchers and students.You will support design flows covering all aspects of IC design with a strong focus on analog/mixed-signal design flows using the latest tools from Cadence Design System, Synopsys, Mentor Graphics and open-source tools.You will interact with students and researchers to help them with their IC design related questions, chip finishing and submission of ICs to fabrication through MPW and foundry contacts.You will also be asked to develop, adapt and maintain common building blocks for mixed-signal IC chips as well as the development of larger mixed-signal ICs.As part of a team supporting research and teaching at ETH Zurich, you will frequently be challenged to develop solutions for systems that stretch the boundaries of conventional approaches.You will be asked to help researchers and students through design reviews.You will also develop and deliver targeted training modules and hands-on laboratory sessions for students and researchers in these areas.In addition, you will contribute to the group's outreach and visibility by supporting its web presence and preparing periodic activity reports.Ihr ProfilWe are looking for an experienced IC designer with strong expertise in analog/mixed-signal design, motivated to work in an environment where creative technical problem-solving supports researchers and students. A track record of multiple successful analog/mixed-signal tape-outs across a range of technology nodes, including advanced ones such as 22nm and FinFET, is required, as is experience leading chip tape-out projects. Proficiency with UNIX, scripting languages, and IC design tools from major EDA vendors is also required. Experience organizing technical training courses and undergraduate laboratory activities is highly desirable. The ideal candidate combines strong communication and technical skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences and is comfortable taking on a leading and senior technical role within the team.Wir bietenWe are a small support team of four permanent employees, and are looking forward to add a fifth member to the team. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our team. jobs.title: Lab Manager and Experimental Technical Support Staff
jobs.description: EinleitungstextAt the IDEAL Lab, we develop algorithms and computational models that design physical hardware and validate those designs via physical experiments. We have a growing physical footprint that includes 3D printers, a custom foam cutter, several robotic arms (UR5e), and a variety of small mechatronic test rigs that change depending on the project. We also have a large teaching profile with ~20-30 Bachelor's and Master's students joining the lab each semester for various projects, a subset of which involve robotics or mechatronics-related experiments.ProjekthintergrundWe are looking for a part-time technical staff member to act as a Lab Manager and/or coordinating technician, depending on the skillset of the person. The specific roles and responsibilities of this person — and the amount of time/effort required from them — would depend on what they could do based on their experience or desire for future training/growth. The core task would be basic lab operations and safety, as mentioned below — anticipated ~20% time — with an optional/desired role for additional time being the engineering and student support — initially anticipated at 20% time, however, this has the option to grow in the future depending on the skills, usefulness, and desires of the specific candidate.Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungBasic Lab Operations and Safety (~20% time):Act as the General Safety Representative for the lab. Train incoming students/staff on safety rules and how to use shared equipment (trainings occur 3-4 times per year for 1-2 hours). Update the safety concept, e.g., once per year or as needed.Keep the lab spaces operational, such as managing inventory, handling purchase requests for supplies, retrieving packages as needed, and working with students to ensure workstations are kept clean and organized. Guide students toward other ETH resources (like other technical workshops or facilities) outside of our immediate lab’s perimeter when they have specific questions/needs (e.g., ETH TechPool, off-site laser cutters, Instron machines, etc.).Attend any occasional lab operational meetings with the PI and other staff, or lab retreats as desired, although not recurring lab meetings (unless desired).Engineering and Student Support (~20% time):Where appropriate, support research goals by helping or consulting with students and staff to debug and run physical experiments they have planned. This could include helping them build or debug necessary rigs or platforms for various research projects, automating existing procedures from past research projects to make them easier to extend in the future, or building working knowledge of the lab’s robotic infrastructure to more quickly onboard new student projects. This depends on the specific hands-on skills of the individual candidate, and also the project needs, as existing students/staff will be the ones largely responsible for setting up and maintaining their own infrastructure.Support research goals by coordinating with outside/external partners, for example, ETH TechPool, outside contractors, researchers at other labs or institutions, etc. to deliver or maintain necessary experimental equipment.Maintain the operation of a few lab demos for occasional visitors.Assist, as requested, Ph.D. students and Post-Docs with transitioning their student projects between semesters, e.g., from one set of Thesis students to another, in cases where the project has a physical experiment setup that uses the lab space. jobs.title: Semiconductor Metrology & Quality Control Technician – 100%
jobs.description: Are you the person who enjoy precise, hands-on work with wafers and chips in a cleanroom, and operating metrology equipment such as optical microscopes, die-sorting, SEM? At Lightium, we're building the next generation of thin-film lithium niobate photonic integrated circuits to help AI infrastructure run faster. As we move from development toward volume production, we're looking for a Metrology & Quality Control Technician to own the measurement, inspection and sorting of our wafers and chips, and to make sure every part that leaves Lightium is exactly what our customers expect. Position Summary As part of our Operations team, you will be the day-to-day responsible for metrology and quality control, as well as die sorting and packaging in our semiconductor cleanroom. You will characterize wafers and chips with a broad set of metrology tools (including optical microscopes, SEM), run incoming and outgoing inspection, operate the pick-and-place machine for die sorting and package and document our products with full traceability. You will work closely with our process, design and test engineers, as well as with fab partners and suppliers. Precision and reliable execution are at the core of the job, and your experience will help shape the way we measure, inspect and release our products as we scale. Key Responsibilities Metrology: Perform wafer- and chip-level measurements using SEM, stylus profilometer, optical and confocal microscopes, and ellipsometer (e.g., film thickness, critical dimensions, etch depth and step height, surface topography and defects). Set up and maintain measurement recipes, keep tools calibrated and in good working condition, and coordinate with service providers when needed.  Sorting & Packaging: Sort chips and dies by hand using manual and vacuum tweezers, as well as operate our pick & place machine to sort dies from singulated wafers on tape to industry-standards shipping containers such as GelPak, waffle pack, JEDEC tray. Handle wafer taping, die marking, final sorting, packaging and sealing in vacuum bags. Data & Reporting: Record, analyze and report measurement results in a clear and traceable way, compliant with our data-stack and data ingestion processes. Promptly flag out-of-spec results and deviations to engineering, support root-cause investigations, and help trend key parameters over time. Incoming Quality Control: Inspect incoming wafers, chips and critical materials from fab partners and suppliers against specifications, complete goods acceptance documentation, and handle nonconforming material in coordination with internal stakeholders. Outgoing Quality Control: Perform final visual and dimensional inspection of chips and wafers before shipment, prepare Certificates of Conformance (CoC) and inspection reports for customers, and ensure that packaging meets our quality standards. Traceability: Ensure full traceability of every wafer and chip through consistent labeling and identification, keep inventory and traceability records accurate in our ERP, PLM system for data traceability, and help maintain the same standards across our R&D and production lines. Procedures & Improvement: Contribute to writing and updating work instructions and inspection and measurement procedures as part of our growing quality management system, and suggest practical improvements based on your daily work, including suggestions for engineers for better automations and improvements of our MES system.  What you’ll bring Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in metrology and quality control in semiconductor, photonics, MEMS or a related micro- and nanofabrication environment such as watch industry and medical instruments. Technical education such as an EFZ apprenticeship (e.g., Mikrotechnologe/in, Physiklaborant/in), a higher technical diploma, or an FH degree in a related field. Metrology Know-how: Hands-on operation of SEM, profilometry, optical and confocal microscopy, ellipsometry, as well as pick-and-place machine for die sorting. Solid experience and dexterity with manual handling of wafers and chips with tweezers. Solid understanding of inspection criteria for wafers and dies. Cleanroom Experience: Proven experience working in ISO 5 / ISO 6 cleanrooms and gray-rooms, operating cleanroom equipment ensuring compliance with cleanroom requirements, as well as preventive and regular maintenance and calibration of tools. Precision & Work Ethic: Meticulous, reliable and hardworking. You take pride in getting things right the first time and in documenting your work so others can trust your results. Quality Mindset: Familiarity with quality standards (e.g., ISO 9001), nonconformance handling and traceability. Experience preparing CoCs or inspection reports is a plus. Tools: Comfortable with Microsoft 365, especially Excel for data analysis. Experience with ERP and PLM systems as well as automation and MES is a plus. Interested in using AI tools such as Claude in your daily work. Language Skills: Good English is preferred. German or French or Italian is a plus.

jobs.title: Healthcare Patent Counsel, Digital Health (all genders)
jobs.description: Healthcare Patent Counsel, Digital Health (all genders)Your rôleAs Healthcare Patent Counsel, you will shape the U.S. and global intellectual property strategy for pharmaceutical development projects and commercial products, with a particular focus on digital health and integrated healthcare solutions. You will work at the intersection of pharmaceuticals, software, data, medical devices, and digital health to protect innovation and enable successful development and commercialization. Partnering with scientists, software experts, engineers, and other innovators, you will identify inventions and build patent portfolio strategies that support project and business objectives. Your work will span combination products, software-enabled medical devices, biomarkers, algorithms, data-driven solutions, and connected health ecosystems. You will draft, file, and prosecute patent applications in the United States, Europe, and other international jurisdictions. You will manage oppositions, post-grant proceedings, and other validity matters, including PGRs and IPRs. You will conduct and oversee freedom-to-operate analyses, turn complex findings into clear recommendations, and support patent enforcement, invalidation proceedings, and related legal opinions. You will provide intellectual property advice and negotiation support for contracts, collaborations, licenses, and business development transactions. As part of an expert group for Digital IP, you will advise colleagues across business areas on software, data analysis, and emerging digital technologies. Working closely with Pharmaceutical R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Commercial, Business Development, and Legal teams, you will counsel senior leaders and help define the future of digital healthcare in a collaborative international environment. Who you are•    You hold a university degree in biomedical engineering, chemistry, biology, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related scientific discipline, together with strong bioinformatics expertise.•    You are registered to practice before the European Patent Office (EPO) and/or the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO).•    You bring substantial experience in a patent department within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or life sciences industry, or in a law firm advising on digital health, software, medical devices, or related healthcare technologies.•    You have a strong understanding of patentability and legal issues relating to software, artificial intelligence and machine learning, data analytics, digital biomarkers, and personalized healthcare.•    You have demonstrated experience in patent drafting and prosecution, post-grant proceedings such as oppositions, PGRs, or IPRs, and freedom-to-operate analyses.•    You have supported or led contract negotiations involving intellectual property, licensing, collaborations, or related commercial arrangements.•    You communicate complex intellectual property matters clearly to technical and non-technical audiences and build trusted relationships with diverse stakeholders.•    You take a collaborative, proactive, and strategic approach, work effectively in international cross-functional teams, and understand the regulatory frameworks for pharmaceutical products, medical devices, and digital health solutions. https://careers.merckgroup.com/fr/fr/apply?jobSeqNo=MQAMKDGLOBAL303054EXTERNALFRFR&step=1&stepname=personalInformation

évolutions applicatives et les études de faisabilité.Vous êtes capable de passer d'une problématique fonctionnelle à une investigation technique approfondie, puis à la définition et à la mise en œuvre d'une solution adaptée.Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les utilisateurs des établissements hospitaliers, les équipes informatiques internes et les fournisseurs de solutions.Votre rôle repose sur un équilibre entre expertise opérationnelle, compréhension métier, autonomie technique et capacité à prendre du recul sur les solutions proposées. **Vos principales activités et de données, serveurs, interfaces et composants techniques.  * Exploiter les bases de données, notamment au travers de requêtes SQL avancées, pour analyser les anomalies et identifier les actions correctives.  * Réaliser les premières investigations techniques et solliciter les expertises spécialisées lorsque la situation le nécessite.  * Anticiper les risques liés aux évolutions technologiques, aux incompatibilités et à l'obsolescence des composants applicatifs.   **Expertise technique et intégration des systèmes*** Comprendre les architectures applicatives et les mécanismes d'intégration entre systèmes hétérogènes.  * Analyser les échanges de données, les interfaces et les webservices afin d'identifier et de résoudre les problèmes d'interopérabilité.  * Lire, comprendre techniques.  * Collaborer avec les équipes de développement, d'infrastructure et d'interopérabilité pour assurer la cohérence et la maintenabilité des solutions.   **Évolution des applications et analyse des besoins métier*** Recueillir, analyser et challenger les besoins exprimés par les utilisateurs et les établissements hospitaliers.  * Comprendre les processus métier dans leur globalité et mesurer les impacts des évolutions sur les utilisateurs et les applications interconnectées.  * Traduire les besoins opérationnels en solutions fonctionnelles et techniques adaptées.  * Réaliser des analyses de faisabilité intégrant les contraintes techniques, les dépendances, les coûts, les délais et les risques.  * Proposer des solutions pragmatiques, proportionnées aux besoins et compatibles avec les ressources disponibles.  * Participer à la planification et à la réalisation des évolutions applicatives, des montées de version et des projets de transformation.  * Organiser les tests techniques et coordonner les validations fonctionnelles avant les mises en production.  * Contribuer à la gestion du cycle de vie des applications et à leur amélioration continue.   **Collaboration et accompagnement des utilisateurs*** Être un interlocuteur de référence pour les équipes métier, les équipes IT et les fournisseurs.  * Échanger avec des interlocuteurs variés, notamment les professionnels de santé, les équipes administratives et les responsables informatiques des établissements.  * Vulgariser les problématiques techniques et expliquer clairement les impacts des différentes options envisagées.  * Challenger de manière constructive les demandes métier et les propositions des fournisseurs.  * Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l'évolution de leurs pratiques et développement logiciel, complétée par une évolution vers la gestion applicative, constitue un parcours particulièrement intéressant. **Compétences techniques***  **Maîtrise avancée de SQL**, notamment pour les requêtes complexes, l'analyse et la manipulation de données, l'investigation d'incidents et la compréhension des procédures stockées.  * Bonne compréhension du développement applicatif, Vous coordonnez les ressources et accompagnez les équipes tout en garantissant la satisfaction des clients et la rentabilité des affaires. **VOS RESPONSABILITES PRINCIPALES** * **Gestion de projets :** planifier et coordonner les chantiers sous votre responsabilité.* **Suivi financier et administratif :** établir les offres et métrés, contrôler les coûts et les heures, assurer la facturation et le suivi des affaires.* **Organisation et encadrement :** planifier les ressources, gérer les commandes et le matériel, accompagner les monteurs et apprentis.* **Service après\-vente et clientèle :** traiter les demandes, organiser les interventions, développer les prestations et fidéliser la clientèle.* **Sécurité et conformité :** garantir le respect des normes OIBT et NIBT, des prescriptions de sécurité et assurer le suivi des contrôles et avis officiels. **VOTRE PROFIL** * CFC d'installateur\-électricien, complété par un brevet fédéral de chef de projet, de conseiller en sécurité électrique ou une maîtrise fédérale, ou formation jugée équivalente.* Minimum 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction similaire, avec conduite d'équipe et gestion de chantiers.* Solides connaissances techniques en installations électriques, ainsi qu'en gestion de projets et suivi financier.* Bonne maîtrise des normes électriques et des outils informatiques.* Langue maternelle française ; allemand, un atout.* Personnalité autonome, organisée et proactive, dotée d'un bon esprit d'analyse, d'un sens aigu du service et de bonnes aptitudes relationnelles. **CE QUE NOUS VOUS OFFRONS*** Un poste varié et stimulant, au cœur des activités électriques de notre région.* Une fonction autonome avec des responsabilités et une réelle proximité avec la clientèle.* Un environnement de travail dynamique, au sein d'une équipe de professionnels engagés.* La possibilité de mettre à profit vos compétences techniques, organisationnelles et commerciales.* Un cadre de travail moderne* Et bien plus ici : Des renseignements complémentaires peuvent être obtenus auprès du Capital Humain au \+![Gruyère Energie S.A.]()* Gruyère Energie S.A.  Rue de l'Etang 20  1630 Bulle*jidd4be31cjm jit1145jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Key Account Supply Chain Manager
jobs.description: **Purpose of the role**  *  As a Key Account Supply Chain Manager, you will be a customer-facing supply chain expert responsible for managing relationships with assigned key accounts and supporting global account strategies.  *  You will work in a dynamic, global environment requiring strong analytical skills, agility, and a proactive mindset to drive customer satisfaction.**Responsibilities**  *  Act as the main point of contact for customers on operational supply chain topics  *  Ensure execution of defined supply chain strategies across all product lines  *  Support the Global Account Supply Chain Manager (GASCM) with analysis, scenario modeling, and business reviews  *  Create, manage, and analyze KPIs (e.g., On-Time Delivery, Lead Time, Inventory, Forecast Accuracy)  *  Provide performance insights and track improvement actions  *  Monitor supply chain performance via control tower tools to identify risks and opportunities  *  Orchestrate internal supply chain functions (planning, logistics, operations) to meet customer needs  *  Manage and execute supply chain agreements (e.g., consignment, stocking programs)  *  Act as the first point of escalation for operational supply chain issues**Qualifications:**  *  Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or similar  *  3–5 years of experience in supply chain, demand planning, or customer service within a global organization (high-tech or semiconductor industry preferred)  *  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with proven execution capability  *  Advanced Excel skills (mandatory) and experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI)  *  Experience with ERP systems, preferably MS Dynamics 365 (F&amp;O)  *  Solid understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes  *  Excellent communication and collaboration skills in an international environment  *  Highly customer-focused, proactive, and detail-oriented  *  Fluent in English; German is a strong advantage

jobs.title: Front Office Agent 100 % (w/m/i)
jobs.description: Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5 Sterne Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5 Sterne Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3 Sterne) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz – eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit Stolz erfüllt.Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarungeine/n Front Office Agent 100 % (w/m/i) Aufgaben: - Durchführen von Check-In/Check-Out unter Einhaltung der LQA Standards- Anreisevorbereitung auf täglicher Basis- Bearbeiten von täglichen Checklisten der Rezeption- Verkauf von Hotelgutscheinen- Erfassen von Reservationen für Zimmer und Restaurants am Desk- aktiver Zusatzverkauf [mit attraktiver Gewinnbeteiligung]- Vorbeugen und Handeln von Gästebeschwerden in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Senior Leadership Team des Front Office- Annahme von In Room Dining Bestellungen- Annahme und Koordination von diversen Gästeanfragen- Arbeiten im Früh-/Mittel-/Spätdienst mit einzelnen Einsätzen im NachtdienstSie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im administrativen Bereich. - Idealerweise bringen Sie bereits Erfahrungen im Tourismus oder in der Hotellerie mit. Deutsch, Englisch und vorzugsweise auch Französisch beherrschen Sie fliessend in Wort und Schrift. - Schicht- und Wochenendarbeiten sind für Sie selbstverständlich. Sie zeigen hohe Leistungsbereitschaft, sind sehr flexibel und belastbar und arbeiten auch unter Zeit- und Arbeitsdruck ruhig, exakt und effizient. Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. jobs.title: Technical Supplier Manager
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Technical Supplier Manager--- Technical Supplier Manager==========================Switzerland bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are based here. For our long\-standing client, Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz, we are looking for a:**Technical Supplier Manager**==============================At Diagnostics, we develop and deliver life\-critical diagnostic solutions that support healthcare professionals and patients worldwide.As part of the Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) organization within the Global Instrument Network (GIN), you will play a key role in ensuring robust manufacturing processes, reliable supplier performance, and long\-term supply security.You will act as the technical interface between internal engineering and operations teams and international contract manufacturing partners. Your responsibilities include technical ownership of instrument components, subassemblies, and production lines, with a strong focus on manufacturing process design, validation, and industrialization.You will also lead external\-to\-external (E2E) technology transfers, second\-sourcing initiatives, and capacity expansions to ensure consistent product quality and reliable supply.**Your Responsibilities**### *Manufacturing Process Design \& Industrialization** Design, develop, optimize, and industrialize manufacturing and testing processes for instrument components, electronics, and precision assemblies across external supplier sites.* Define and implement process validation strategies (IQ/OQ/PQ), design verification protocols, and process capability assessments, including Cp/Cpk, tolerance studies, and Gage R\&R.* Collaborate with R\&D during early product development to integrate Design for Manufacturing, Assembly, and Testability (DfX) principles, improve yields, and prevent manufacturing bottlenecks.* Identify and mitigate manufacturing risks through pFMEA, poka\-yoke (error\-proofing), and structured root\-cause investigations.### *Technical Project Leadership \& Technology Transfers** Lead external\-to\-external (E2E) technology transfers between contract manufacturers and suppliers, including production line relocations, tool duplications, and second\-source qualifications.* Develop qualification master plans (QMPs), coordinate project schedules and milestones, and provide transparent progress reporting to MSAT and GIN leadership.* Ensure technical alignment and effective change control between transferring and receiving supplier sites, Global Sourcing, Quality Assurance, and Regulatory Affairs.### *Technical Supplier Management \& Operations Support** Monitor supplier manufacturing processes, technical KPIs, process stability, and component quality throughout the instrument lifecycle.* Lead technical investigations and sustainable corrective actions for component deviations and Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs), using methods such as 8D, Ishikawa, and 5\-Why.* Conduct technical supplier assessments and audits to support the qualification of new and existing manufacturing partners.* Manage supplier\-side engineering changes without specification changes, capacity expansions, and continuous production line stabilization initiatives.*  **Your Profile**### *Education \& Professional Experience** University degree (Bachelor's or Master's) or Higher Technical Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.* At least 5–6 years of relevant industry experience in manufacturing process design, technical supplier management, industrialization, or manufacturing engineering, ideally within medical devices, in\-vitro diagnostics (IVD), pharmaceuticals, or precision high\-tech equipment.### *Technical Expertise** Proven hands\-on experience in designing, qualifying, and optimizing manufacturing and testing processes.* Strong knowledge of statistical process control (SPC), process capability studies (Cp/Cpk), measurement systems analysis (MSA), and pFMEA.* Solid understanding of precision manufacturing technologies, such as injection molding, precision mechanics and machining, electronics assembly, and automated testing.* Understanding of manufacturing cost drivers and cycle time optimization.* Practical knowledge of ISO 13485, GMP/FDA regulations, process validation (IQ/OQ/PQ), and formal change management procedures.### *Project Management \& Collaboration** Demonstrated experience leading complex technical projects, particularly external\-to\-external technology transfers, second\-sourcing initiatives, or major production line ramp\-ups.* A project management certification (PMP, IPMA, Agile) is an advantage.* Pragmatic and innovative problem\-solving skills, with the ability to think outside the box.* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with international and cross\-functional stakeholders.### *Languages \& Travel** Professional fluency in English and , both written and spoken.* Willingness to travel internationally approximately 20–30% for supplier process reviews, audits, and technology transfer milestones.*  ### **What We Offer*** The opportunity to work for one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.* A modern campus with extensive green spaces and meeting areas.* A central location with easy access to the motorway and a nearby train station.* A varied range of responsibilities.* Home office opportunities.* The opportunity to work in a dynamic and motivated team.* Very good compensation.Please send your complete application documents to Ms .Chemistry, Pharmaceuticals, Pharmacy, Diagnostics, Zug, Lucerne, Full\-time, Strategic, Lead, Manager![Elan Personal AG]()* Elan Personal AG  4051 Basel*jid8f1c5c2jm jit1145jm jiy26jm

Now, we are opening the next chapter by making AI an everyday tool \- for our customers as well as our 1,700 foundations are in place: Our AI policy has been approved, and initial applications are already up and running. Now, we are looking for you: someone who can identify the right opportunities, bring people along on the journey, and ensure that ideas translate into measurable value. You will report directly to our Group CFO, build a small interdisciplinary team, and have significant freedom to shape this transformation \- guided by the principle: "Centralize the foundation. Federate the value creation." Your workplace will be our headquarters in Allschwil, in the canton of Basel\-Landschaft, Switzerland.  **Responsibilities** * You develop the Group\-wide AI roadmap and manage a prioritized portfolio of initiatives based on business value, customer value, feasibility, and risk.* Together with the business functions, you identify where AI can make the greatest difference in processes, products, and services.* You lead selected flagship projects from initial idea and business case through to production deployment \- and measure their success.* You scale what works and consistently discontinue initiatives that fail to deliver added value.* In collaboration with ICT, you drive the broad and secure adoption of Group\-approved AI tools and bring AI agents and automated workflows to the areas where they can deliver meaningful impact.* You build a network of AI Champions and Power Users and embed AI into SKAN's existing Operating Model.* You bring Business, ICT, Security, Quality, Legal, HR, and Finance together and ensure transparency around usage, value, costs, and risks \- providing the basis for informed Executive Management decisions.   **Hardskills*** A completed degree in track record of leading initiatives from strategy through production deployment and scaling.* A solid understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models, and AI agents \- as well as what it takes to ensure AI operates securely and at scale within an organization: integration, data, access permissions, and security.* You evaluate AI initiatives based on business value, feasibility, and risk, and manage them through business cases and measurable outcomes.* Experience leading cross\-functional initiatives and managing stakeholders up to Executive Management level.* Experience in industry, engineering, pharmaceuticals, or life sciences, or in regulated environments, is a plus.* Excellent English skills; language skills are an advantage.   **Softskills** * You inspire confidence through your personality \- whether engaging with Executive Management, engineers, or specialists.* You think strategically and are equally willing to roll up your sleeves and get things done.* You distill complexity into what really matters and provide clear recommendations.* You bring people together across functional boundaries, even without direct line management responsibility.* You challenge the status quo with confidence and work collaboratively without getting caught up in consensus for its own sake.* You are curious and a fast learner \- while remaining focused on facts and measurable value rather than being driven by hype.  **We offer you*** A Group\-wide mission to shape and drive AI transformation, with a direct reporting line to the Group CFO* The opportunity to make AI impactful in an area that contributes to the safe manufacturing of pharmaceuticals and vaccines* An open and collaborative corporate culture* Freedom to develop and implement your ideas* Access to jobs.title: Photolithography Process Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: **The opportunity:**Join a high-performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact.As a Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards.This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long-term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance.Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today!**How you’ll make an impact****Process development and optimization:**• Ensure processes meet the production program and yield goals and address any product yield and rework issues.• Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects.• Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC).**Equipment and production support:**• Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line.• Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line.• Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay.**Cross-functional collaboration**• Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production.**On-call responsibilities**• On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers.**Your background****Education and professional experience:**• Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master’s degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience.• Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing).**Technical skills and expertise:**• Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis.• Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography.• Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred.**Personal and language skills:**• Good English and German language skills.• Ability to work in a cleanroom environment.**More about us:**Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.description: **The opportunity:**Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools?As a Diffusion Maintenance Engineer/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park.Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of diffusion equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line.**How you’ll make an impact:**• Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of diffusion equipment.• Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology.• Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency.• Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability.• Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance.• strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations.**Your background:****Technical experience and expertise**•    Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools.•    Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics.•    Experience with diffusion systems (e.g. ASM, centrotherm ovens).•    Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (e.g., Surfscan, Semilab WT-2000).•    Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies.**Education and qualifications:**• Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field).**Personal skills and requirements:**• Willingness to work in shifts is a must.• Strong team jobs.title: Philanthropy Support Team Coordinator
jobs.description: We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.Inclusivity and Diversity at MSFDo your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. If you believe your profile is a good match for this position, we invite you to apply even if you don’t fulfil every listed qualification.We encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, background, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks.Context & missionMédecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.The Philanthropy Unit of MSF Switzerland is responsible for the acquisition, cultivation and stewardship of around 2,000 major donors — Foundations, Individuals, Corporates, Cantons and Communes — through relationship management and one-to-one donor engagement. The Unit generates a significant share of MSF Switzerland’s annual income, enabling much-needed medical emergency responses.The three donor-facing teams, comprising 14 Philanthropy Advisors and two interns based in Geneva, Zurich and Lugano, are supported by two teams: experienced, multilingual Writing Officers responsible for producing proposals and reports, and the Enablers team, consisting of two experienced Support Specialists and an intern, covering Due Diligence, Business Intelligence, Prospect Research, Processes and the interface with the CRM Unit. Their work is key to ensuring donor satisfaction, proximity to MSF’s social mission, professionalism and adaptation to changing donor behaviour and market conditions.The Philantropy support team coordinator is a newly created role in response to the Unit’s growth in investment, income and complexity. The role steers the contribution of the support functions to long-term income growth through effective coordination, clear prioritisation and team management. It provides line management to Writers and Enablers, ensures alignment with the Unit’s needs, manages workloads and facilitates collaboration with donor-facing teams, while anticipating changes in the philanthropy environment.Writers and Enablers continue to work directly with colleagues across the Unit in their respective areas of expertise, with the role supporting them in bringing this expertise into the Unit’s work.As a member of the Philanthropy Management Team, the coordinator contributes to Unit-wide planning and decision-making and represents the perspective and needs of the support functions.
