jobs.title: Quality & Environmental Manager, Auramo Oy
jobs.description: Would you like to take a leading role in quality and environmental management within an international manufacturing group? We are looking for a proactive and hands-on Quality & Environmental Manager to lead and develop these activities at Auramos factory in Järvenpää.BOLZONI is one of the worlds leading manufacturers of material handling solutions. The Group designs, manufactures and distributes forklift attachments, forks and lift tables to equipment manufacturers and customers worldwide. Its international operations combine technological expertise, specialised production sites and a strong understanding of customer needs.Auramo Oy is part of BOLZONI and the multinational Hyster-Yale Group. At our Järvenpää factory, we manufacture forklift attachments for the pulp, paper and forest industries.[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/a119c981-3616-4af8-9341-30cc6df400da/original.png]What will you be doing?As Quality & Environmental Manager, you will lead quality and environmental management at Auramo's Järvenpää factory. Your responsibility is to ensure that products, processes and management systems meet customer, corporate and regulatory requirements while driving continuous improvement across the organization.You will take ownership of quality and environmental performance, reporting and management systems, translating objectives into practical ways of working together with production and other key functions. The role includes monitoring KPI and PPM performance, leading root cause analyses and corrective actions, and turning data into meaningful improvements and business decisions.Working closely with colleagues across the factory and the wider Bolzoni Group, you will contribute to shared practices, support operational excellence and help foster a culture of structured problem-solving and continuous improvement.This is a permanent, full-time position based at Auramo's factory in Järvenpää. We hope you can start in February 2027.What are we looking for?A strong background in quality management within the manufacturing industry is essential for success in this role. A degree in mechanical engineering, production engineering or another relevant technical field will provide a solid foundation for the position.You understand quality management systems, customer requirements and industrial production processes. Experience in KPI and PPM monitoring, root cause analysis and corrective actions will help you succeed in translating data into practical improvements and informed business decisions.Experience working closely with production organisations is essential, while experience in an international environment is considered an advantage. Strong Excel and Microsoft Office skills are expected, and familiarity with SAP is beneficial.Good written and spoken English is required. Finnish language skills are considered an advantage.In this position, you combine analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach. You are comfortable taking ownership, setting priorities and building effective cooperation across functions and stakeholders.Why join us?At Auramo, you will have a broad and influential role with the opportunity to shape quality and environmental management in a growing international business. Your work will directly impact product quality, customer satisfaction, compliance and operational performance.The position combines close-to-production responsibility with international cooperation across Bolzoni Group and Hyster-Yale. Alongside meaningful work, we offer flexible working hours, comprehensive occupational healthcare, lunch and sports benefits, and your own office.Most importantly, you'll have the freedom to apply your expertise, improve ways of working and contribute to the future development of the business.Interested?If this opportunity sounds like the right next step in your career, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application through the application link as soon as possible, but no later than 22 November 2026. Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted throughout the application period.The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For further information about the position, please contact Saija Salter at saija.salter@biisoni.fi [saija.salter@biisoni.fi].Please note that applications are only accepted through our recruitment system. Applications submitted by email will not be considered.

As the existing components will remain in production during the uplift, testing will play an important role in ensuring both the quality of the new functionality and the stability of existing features. As a QA Engineer, you will be responsible for testing new and updated UI components, performing regression testing, and ensuring that existing functionality continues to work as expected throughout the modernization.

- Minimum 3 years of professional frontend testing/QA experience
- Experience with mobile application testing
- Experience with web application testing
- Experience with non-functional testing, including accessibility testing
- Good understanding of relevant testing methodologies, standards, technologies, and tools
- Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned testing activities
- Proactive approach to identifying, communicating, and resolving potential issues Preferred 

Skills:
- UI component testing
- Regression testing
- Test automation
- Previous experience testing IT solutions within the financial or banking sector

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have at least 3 years of professional experience in software testing/QA?*
- Do you have hands-on experience with both mobile application testing and web application testing?*
- Do you have experience with non-functional testing, including accessibility testing?*
- Do you have experience with regression testing and/or UI component testing?*
- Do you have previous experience testing IT solutions within the banking or financial sector?

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role.

Location: Helsinki, Finland (hybrid)
Allocation: 100 %
Start date: Asap
End date: 31.3.2027, possible extension
Language: Fluent in English

Please include your salary expectation in your application. For more information, contact Kimmo Kärsämä, tel. 050 412 7500, kimmo.karsama@lokki.fi

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer, High Voltage (GIS); Location: DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Are you a seasoned HV engineer with extensive GIS expertise? Do you understand what it takes to specify the right GIS solution and navigate the trade-offs between performance, reliability, cost, footprint and delivery schedules? Can you translate customer requirements into practical, value-driven solutions? Then join our team and help shape the projects that are driving the global transition towards renewable energy!Your position In your new position, you will be a key contributor to our major tender projects, collaborating closely with a team of experienced engineers to translate customer requirements into robust and scalable offerings. Drawing on your expertise in high-voltage GIS solutions, you will help shape technical decisions, collaborate with strategic suppliers, and strengthen our value proposition.Beyond tender activities, you will contribute to the continuous development of our HV competencies, product portfolio, and ways of working, helping strengthen our technical foundation for future growth.You will join our Product Line Management (PLM) Solution Engineering team, a multidisciplinary group collaborating with customers, suppliers and colleagues across the organization.As part of PLM, you will contribute to our ambition of making offshore substations more modular, standardized, and repeatable.You will help define not only the solutions we deliver today, but also the solutions we bring to market tomorrow.Building on our strong offshore substation capabilities, we are also exploring opportunities within onshore substations. Experience with onshore transmission systems, including EHV GIS/AIS, grid transformers, reactive compensation, harmonic filtering or grid connection equipment, will therefore be considered an advantage and may provide opportunities to contribute beyond our offshore portfolio.Working in an international and collaborative environment, you will help transform proven engineering concepts into repeatable products that support the continued growth of renewable energy worldwide.The position is full-time and includes approximately 10-30 travel days per year. We place a high value on flexibility, and most travel can be planned to align with both business requirements and personal preferences."We have built a leading position within offshore substations, and PLM plays a key role in ensuring that we maintain and strengthen that position. By developing scalable solutions, standardizing our products, and challenging established ways of working, we make sure that we are ready to meet the demands of both today’s and tomorrow’s energy markets. We currently support projects across Europe, the UK, North America, and Asia, but our ambition is simple: to be ready wherever the next opportunity emerges."– Jannick Elmbæk Olsen, Director, Product Line ManagementYour tasks & responsibilitiesAs our new Senior High Voltage Engineer, you will play a key role in the development, positioning, and continuous improvement of the products and solutions offered within our offshore substation product line. Working closely with customers, suppliers, procurement, and our project execution teams, you will help shape solutions that remain competitive, scalable, and aligned with future market demands.Your tasks will include:
  • Support tender activities by defining and evaluating 66 kV and 230/275 kV GIS solutions.
  • Translate customer needs, market trends, and supplier capabilities into competitive product offerings.
  • Optimize solutions with respect to performance, reliability, footprint, cost, and lead time.
  • Develop and maintain the GIS product roadmap in line with future market requirements and emerging technologies.
  • Collaborate with Procurement and strategic suppliers to strengthen competitiveness and drive cost optimization.
  • Contribute to the standardization and modularization of our GIS product portfolio.
  • Ensure a seamless handover of as-sold solutions to our EPC engineering teams.
Your profile & qualifications To succeed in this role, you are an experienced High Voltage Engineer with extensive GIS expertise and a passion for developing competitive solutions for the renewable energy industry.We imagine that you:
  • Hold a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Have extensive experience with medium- and high-voltage GIS systems, including 66 kV array systems and 230/275 kV transmission-level applications, from offshore wind, utilities, transmission, manufacturing, or EPC projects.
  • Experience with offshore GIS applications, technology qualification, or emerging SF6-free switchgear technologies is considered an advantage.
  • Understand the technical and commercial drivers behind GIS selection, including performance, cost, footprint, weight, and lead time.
  • Are comfortable working with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to balance technical and commercial requirements.
  • Have a strategic mindset and enjoy translating market needs into scalable product offerings.
  • Communicate clearly in English and can translate complex technical topics into sound business decisions.
  • Thrive in a collaborative and international environment and enjoy working across disciplines and cultures.
  • If you also bring experience or exposure to onshore substations, grid connections, or related high-voltage systems, we would be interested to hear about it.
Welcome to Semco Maritime At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   Care to join the movement? Change. With us. Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Pladsmedarbejder søges til Bileksport Danmark i Ringsted
jobs.description:
Pladsmedarbejder søges til Bileksport Danmark i Ringsted

Er du arbejdsom, praktisk anlagt og en holdspiller med godt humør? Og er du ikke bange for at få beskidte fingre? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Bileksport Danmark ApS søger en ny kollega til vores logistikteam på Huginsvej 6 i Ringsted.

Vi er en international virksomhed, der eksporterer omkring 100 biler om måneden. Der er fart på i hverdagen, og vi har brug for en kollega, der kan tage fat, holde overblikket og være med til at få den daglige drift til at fungere.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift på vores bilplads. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

•

Modtagelse og registrering af indkommende biler

•

Flytning og organisering af biler på pladsen

•

Håndtering af bilnøgler og registreringsattester

•

Klargøring af biler til afhentning og eksport

•

Støvsugning, lettere rengøring og praktisk klargøring af biler

•

Udfyldelse af CRM-dokumenter og lettere administrative opgaver

•

Andre praktiske opgaver, der får hverdagen til at glide

Det er en aktiv og alsidig stilling, hvor du både kommer til at bruge hænderne og hovedet. Du skal derfor trives med fysisk arbejde og være klar til at tage fat på både store og små opgaver.

Hvem er du?

Vi går mere op i din indstilling end i din uddannelse og erfaring.

Det vigtigste for os er, at du:

•

Har en stærk arbejdsmoral. Du møder til tiden, tager ansvar og gør dig umage.

•

Er en holdspiller. Du hjælper dine kollegaer og bidrager til, at vi lykkes sammen.

•

Har godt humør. Du bidrager med positiv energi, også når der er travlt.

•

Arbejder struktureret og fokuseret. Du kan holde styr på detaljerne og bevare overblikket.

•

Er praktisk anlagt. Du tager fat og er ikke for fin til at støvsuge en bil eller få beskidte fingre.

•

Har gode engelskkundskaber. Du kan kommunikere på engelsk og både tale og forstå sproget på et godt niveau.

•

Har almindelige IT-færdigheder. Du er vant til at arbejde på computer og har erfaring med eksempelvis Outlook og Excel.

•

Har almindeligt kørekort, kategori B.

Du behøver ikke have erfaring fra bilbranchen. Det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og lyst til at lære.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos Bileksport Danmark får du en arbejdsplads med højt tempo, korte beslutningsveje og masser af personlighed.

Vi er et internationalt team med forskellige nationaliteter og baggrunde. Engelsk er en naturlig del af hverdagen og bliver blandt andet talt omkring frokostbordet.

Vi arbejder hårdt, men vi har det også sjovt.

Der er plads til humor, en uformel omgangstone og til at være den, man er. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes af mennesker, der tager deres arbejde seriøst, uden nødvendigvis at tage sig selv alt for højtideligt.

Hos os får du:

•

En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

•

En aktiv og varieret arbejdsdag

•

Et internationalt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø

•

Gode kollegaer og et stærkt fællesskab

•

Frihed under ansvar

•

En arbejdsplads, hvor din indsats gør en reel forskel

Praktisk information

Stilling: Pladsmedarbejder, fuldtid Arbejdstid: 37 timer om ugen Arbejdssted: Huginsvej 6, 4100 Ringsted Virksomhed: Bileksport Danmark ApS Kørekort: Kategori B er et krav Sprog: Gode mundtlige engelskkundskaber er et krav. Dansk er ikke nødvendigt

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til Kasper@bileksportdanmark.dk.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Bileksport Danmark ApS

jobs.title: Personalkonsult till Barona i Vasa
jobs.description: Tycker du om att arbeta med människor, skapa goda relationer och hitta lösningar? Trivs du i en varierande arbetsvardag där du får ta ansvar, arbeta självständigt och samarbeta med andra? Då kan du vara den kollega vi söker!Vi söker nu en personalkonsult till vårt team i Vasa. I rollen arbetar du främst med våra industrikunder i Österbotten och har en viktig uppgift i att sammanföra rätt människor med rätt arbetsplatser. Vi söker dig som kan kommunicera obehindrat på både svenska och finska, i tal och skrift, och som trivs i en roll med mycket kontakt med människor.Som personalkonsult får du ett mångsidigt arbete där rekrytering, personalfrågor och kundrelationer är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du har nära kontakt med både våra kundföretag och medarbetare och bidrar till att samarbetet fungerar smidigt från rekrytering till avslutad anställning.Hos oss blir du en del av ett engagerat team där vi hjälper varandra och arbetar tillsammans för att hitta de bästa lösningarna. Arbetsdagarna är varierande och tempot kan tidvis vara högt, men det är också det som gör arbetet intressant.Vad innebär arbetet?Som personalkonsult är du en viktig kontaktperson för våra kundföretag, arbetssökande och uthyrda medarbetare. Du ansvarar för rekryteringsprocesser och ser till att våra medarbetare får det stöd de behöver under sin anställning.Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat:- Planering och genomförande av rekryteringar från början till slut.- Utformning och publicering av platsannonser samt hantering och bedömning av ansökningar.- Intervjuer och löpande kontakt med arbetssökande.- Aktiv kontakt med våra kundföretag, uppföljning av deras personalbehov och utveckling av kundrelationerna.- Löpande kontakt och stöd till våra uthyrda medarbetare via telefon, e-post och personliga möten.- Hantering av personalrelaterade ärenden under hela anställningens livscykel.- Identifiering av nya kundbehov och samarbetsmöjligheter.Arbetet innebär många kontakter och varierande situationer. Därför är det viktigt att du kan organisera din arbetsdag, prioritera mellan olika uppgifter och ta initiativ när det behövs.Du arbetar självständigt med dina ansvarsområden, men har alltid stöd av dina kollegor och Baronas övriga experter.Vem söker vi?Vi söker dig som trivs med att arbeta med människor och har ett genuint intresse för rekrytering, personalfrågor och kundrelationer.Du har lätt för att skapa kontakt med olika människor och förstår vikten av god service och tydlig kommunikation. Du är ansvarstagande, noggrann och har förmågan att hålla ordning på flera uppgifter samtidigt.Vi uppskattar att du är initiativrik, flexibel och har en praktisk inställning till problemlösning. Vi värdesätter också din vilja att lära dig nytt och utvecklas i rollen.För att lyckas i rollen önskar vi att du har:- Förmåga att kommunicera obehindrat på både svenska och finska, i tal och skrift.- God kommunikationsförmåga och lätt för att samarbeta med olika människor.- Ett strukturerat arbetssätt och förmåga att arbeta självständigt.- Goda digitala färdigheter och lätt för att lära dig nya system.- Förmåga att prioritera och hantera flera uppgifter samtidigt.- Ett intresse för rekrytering, HR och kundarbete.Tidigare erfarenhet av rekrytering, HR, personalservice eller kundarbete är meriterande. Även erfarenhet från industrin eller kännedom om det österbottniska näringslivet ser vi som en fördel.Eftersom vi arbetar med människor med olika språklig och kulturell bakgrund är kunskaper i engelska också värdefulla.För oss är din inställning, samarbetsförmåga och vilja att utvecklas minst lika viktiga som din tidigare erfarenhet.Vad erbjuder vi dig?Hos Barona får du ett varierande arbete med möjlighet att utvecklas och påverka hur arbetet görs. Du får arbeta nära både människor och företag och vara en del av ett team där vi värdesätter samarbete, ansvar och en god arbetsgemenskap.Vi erbjuder dig:- Ett mångsidigt och ansvarsfullt arbete med varierande arbetsuppgifter.- Ett engagerat och hjälpsamt team där vi stöttar varandra.- En introduktion till arbetet och stöd från erfarna kollegor.- Möjlighet att utveckla både din egen kompetens och våra arbetssätt.- Frihet och ansvar i det dagliga arbetet.- Flexibla arbetstider, med arbetet huvudsakligen förlagt till dagtid.- En månadslön på 2 500-3 000 euro, beroende på din erfarenhet och kompetens.Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats är Baronas kontor på Rostensgatan 1, 65100 Vasa.Barona som arbetsgivareBarona är ett finländskt arbetslivsföretag som hjälper människor och företag att hitta nya möjligheter i arbetslivet. Vi erbjuder tjänster inom bland annat rekrytering, personalservice och utveckling av arbetslivet.Hos oss får du möjligheten att arbeta i ett stort företag med bred kompetens och många olika verksamhetsområden, samtidigt som du blir en del av ett lokalt team med nära samarbete.Vår arbetskultur bygger på frihet, ansvar, mod och att göra saker tillsammans. Vi tror på att ge människor förtroende, uppmuntra till utveckling och hjälpa varandra att lyckas.Vill du bli vår nya kollega?Låter det här som ett arbete som skulle passa dig? Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!Skicka in din ansökan via vårt ansökningsformulär och berätta gärna lite om dig själv och varför du är intresserad av tjänsten.Vi behandlar ansökningar och träffar kandidater redan under ansökningstiden, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.Observera att vi av datasäkerhetsskäl endast behandlar ansökningar som skickas via ansökningsformuläret, inte per e-post.Mer information om tjänsten:Kristoffer WörlundOmrådeschef och ansvarig för rekryteringen0505200200

interpersonal skills.Organised, hands-on, and able to manage multiple operations concurrently.Proactive, safety-conscious, and solutions-oriented.Comfortable working in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

jobs.title: Construction Logistics Health & Safety Manager
jobs.description: We are seeking a safety-driven and proactive Construction Logistics Health & Safety Manager to lead and manage all health, safety, and environmental (HSE) matters associated with logistics operations on a major hyperscale data centre project in Hamina, Finland. jobs.title: Kvalitetssikringsmedarbejder søges til Firesafe Danmark A/S
jobs.description:
Kvalitetssikringsmedarbejder søges til Firesafe Danmark A/S

Har du øje for kvalitet, teknisk forståelse og lyst til at arbejde tæt på byggeprocessen?

Hos Firesafe Danmark A/S søger vi to kvalitetssikringsmedarbejdere til at styrke vores kvalitetssikring inden for passiv brandsikring og isolering. Vi søger strukturerede og kvalitetsbevidste medarbejdere med teknisk forståelse.

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor du kombinerer praktiske kvalitetstilsyn på byggepladsen med teknisk opfølgning og dokumentation. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med montører, projektledere og øvrige kolleger.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

·         Udføre løbende kvalitetstilsyn og kontrol af passiv brandsikring og isoleringsarbejde.

·         Kontrollere, at arbejdet udføres i overensstemmelse med tekniske tegninger, montagevejledninger og gældende krav.

·         Identificere kvalitetsafvigelser og følge op på nødvendige udbedringer.

·         Udarbejde og vedligeholde kvalitetsdokumentation samt registrere og følge op på opgaver i Dalux og BIM.

·         Vejlede montører i korrekte arbejdsmetoder og tekniske løsninger, herunder demonstrere korrekt udførelse.

·         Samarbejde med ledelsen om tekniske afklaringer, koordinering og kvalitetsopfølgning.

Vi forventer, at du:

•         Har teknisk forståelse og interesse for kvalitetssikring.

•         Kan læse og forstå bygningstegninger og teknisk dokumentation.

•         Arbejder selvstændigt, systematisk og følger dine opgaver til dørs.

•         Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt.

•         Er fortrolig med digitale værktøjer og har lyst til at arbejde med kvalitetsdokumentation.

•         Kan vejlede montører og følge op på kvaliteten af det udførte arbejde.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har:

•         Erfaring med kvalitetssikring og kontrol i byggebranchen.

•         Kendskab til passiv brandsikring, isolering eller lignende teknisk arbejde.

•         Erfaring med Dalux og BIM.

•         Gode danskkundskaber og kendskab til flere sprog.

Der stilles ikke krav om en bestemt uddannelse, dog er det en fordele hvis man har en teknisk baggrund. 

Vi tilbyder

•         Fast fuldtidsstilling på minimum 37 timer om ugen.

•         Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

•         Løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring samt pension og øvrige vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

•         Firmatelefon, computer og andet relevant udstyr i forbindelse med arbejdet.

•         En varieret arbejdsdag med både praktiske og administrative opgaver.

•         Et arbejdsmiljø med gode kolleger og mulighed for faglig udvikling.

Om Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S arbejder med passiv brandsikring og relaterede tekniske ydelser på byggeprojekter. Vi bidrager til at beskytte mennesker, bygninger og værdier gennem korrekt udførelse og dokumentation af brandtekniske løsninger.

Hos os bliver du en del af en organisation, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og ansvarlighed er i fokus.

Ansøgning

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig?

Send dit CV og en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for at søge jobbet til info@firesafe.dk

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Søren Christiansen soeren.christiansen@firesafe.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 

  

Quality Assurance Employee Wanted at Firesafe Danmark A/S

Do you have an eye for detail, a strong technical understanding, and a passion for ensuring high quality workmanship on construction sites?

Firesafe Danmark A/S is looking to recruit two Quality Assurance Employees to strengthen our quality assurance team within passive fire protection and insulation works.

In this role, you will combine on-site quality inspections with technical follow-up and documentation. You will work closely with installers, project managers, and other members of the project team to ensure that installations meet the required quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

•         Conduct regular QA/QC inspections of passive fire protection and insulation works on-site.

•         Verify that installations comply with approved drawings, installation instructions, project specifications, and applicable requirements.

•         Identify non-conformities and follow up on corrective actions to ensure proper close-out.

•         Prepare and maintain quality documentation, inspection records, and reports, including the registration and follow-up of quality-related issues in Dalux and BIM models.

•         Provide technical guidance to installers on approved installation methods and demonstrate correct workmanship when required.

•         Coordinate with the project team regarding technical clarifications, site activities, and quality-related matters.

About You

We are looking for a responsible, structured, and solution-oriented individual with strong attention to detail. You are comfortable working both on construction sites and in a site office, and you can communicate effectively with different trades and project stakeholders.

We expect you to:

•         Have a good technical understanding and a strong interest in quality assurance and quality control.

•         Be able to read and interpret construction drawings and technical documentation.

•         Work independently, systematically, and take ownership of your tasks.

•         Communicate effectively in English or Danish, both verbally and in writing.

•         Be comfortable using digital tools for inspections and quality documentation.

•         Be confident in guiding installers and following up on the quality of completed work.

 

It would be an advantage if you have:

•         Previous experience in QA/QC, quality inspections, or construction site supervision.

•         Knowledge of passive fire protection, insulation, or similar construction activities.

•         Experience working with Dalux and BIM.

•         Hands-on construction site experience, including providing technical guidance to installers.

•         Good Danish language skills and knowledge of additional languages.

A specific educational background is not required. We value relevant practical experience, technical understanding, and the right attitude.

What We Offer

•         A permanent, full-time position with a minimum of 37 working hours per week.

•         Start date as soon as possible or by agreement.

•         Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience, including pension and other employment benefits in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and employment contract.

•         Company phone and the possibility of a company vehicle, depending on project requirements.

•         A varied workday combining on-site inspections with office-based QA/QC activities.

•         A supportive and informal working environment with opportunities for professional development.

About Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S specialises in passive fire protection and related technical services within the construction industry.

Our work contributes to protecting people, buildings, and assets by ensuring that fire protection systems are correctly installed, inspected, and documented in accordance with project specifications and applicable requirements.

You will become part of a team where quality, teamwork, and accountability are at the core of our daily operations.

How to Apply

Interested in joining our team?

Please submit your CV along with a short description of your motivation for applying to info@firesafe.dk

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Søren Christiansen soeren.christiansen@firesafe.dk for further information.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Ingénieur DevOps (H/F)
jobs.description: L'Ingénieur(e) DevOps contribue à la conception, à l'automatisation et à la fiabilisation des infrastructures Luminess. Vous maîtrisezArchitecture cloud (Outscale / Azure/ AWS), Kubernetes /Docker, IaC (Terraform, Puppet), VM & sauvegardes, Pipeline CI/CD (Jenkins, Git/Gitflow), Linux, sécurité, performance, serveurs web.Outils : Nutanix, Cloud Outscale, Apache, Rundeck, PostgreSQL/MySQL.Le poste est indiqué sur Laval mais en fonction de votre lieu de résidence il peut-être basé sur Rennes, Compétences personnellesAdaptabilité, communication claire, esprit analytique, pédagogie, travail en équipe, rigueur, sens du service et partage de connaissances.Le groupe LuminessConfiance / Audace / Responsabilité / ExcellenceRejoignez un acteur en pleine transformation au cœur des enjeux de l'IA, de la confiance numérique et des parcours métierChez Luminess, nous avons une ambition claire : devenir un partenaire de référence de la transformation des parcours métier critiques des secteurs Banque, Assurance, Mutuelles et Public.Pour y parvenir, nous ouvrons un nouveau chapitre de notre développement.Nous investissons massivement dans l'intelligence artificielle, l'automatisation, la confiance numérique et la transformation des parcours métier afin d'accompagner les plus grandes organisations françaises dans leurs enjeux les plus stratégiques : amélioration de l'expérience client, conformité réglementaire, lutte contre la fraude, accélération des décisions et excellence opérationnelle.Notre objectif est ambitieux : accélérer fortement notre croissance d'ici 2030 en renforçant notre présence sur nos marchés stratégiques et en développant de nouvelles offres à forte valeur ajoutée.

jobs.title: QEHS Engineer
jobs.description: Are you a proactive quality, environmental, health and safety professional who enjoys improving processes and working closely with production?**We are looking for a forward-thinking QEHS ENGINEER to join our team in Mäntyharju, Finland!**At Exel Composites, quality, health & safety, environmental responsibility and continuous improvement are integral parts of our daily operations. As our new QEHS Engineer, you will play an important role in developing these areas at our Mäntyharju manufacturing site. You will work closely with production and collaborate with application engineering, supply chain, and other functions. You will also interact with customers, suppliers, auditors and authorities as part of your responsibilities.This is a permanent position located at Exel Composites manufacturing site in Mäntyharju, Finland. The position reports to the Site Leader, Mäntyharju.**YOUR ROLE**You will coordinate and develop daily quality, environmental, occupational health and safety activities, ensuring compliance with customer, legal and certification requirements. The role also includes supervising the Mäntyharju laboratory team.Your key responsibilities include:- Maintain QEHS systems and documentation, and coordinate audits and follow-up with the QEHS Manager Finland. - Coordinate risk assessments, incident investigations, safety walks and follow-up actions. - Manage customer complaints, nonconformities and CAPA, including root-cause analysis, reporting and follow-up. - Support production, supplier and new-product quality, improve processes and reduce scrap through continuous improvement. - Monitor environmental compliance and support waste, chemical, emissions and environmental incident management. - Support occupational health, ergonomics and wellbeing with occupational health services. - Organise safety and quality training and inductions, monitor and report QEHS performance. - Act as the site's QEHS contact for customers and authorities within your remit, supporting visits and inspections. **WHAT YOU BRING**You take a practical, solution-focused and organised approach, turning analysis into improvements and involving others in change. You work comfortably in a manufacturing environment.You have:- B.Sc. degree in engineering, mechanical engineering, chemistry or another relevant field. - Experience working in an industrial environment. - Knowledge of quality and production-improvement methods and relevant legal and certification requirements. - Knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems, together with auditing skills. - Strong analytical, root-cause problem-solving and reporting skills. - Good communication skills, with the ability to drive practical improvements. - Good Finnish and English language skills, both written and spoken. **WHAT WE VALUE**The following are considered advantages:- Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, statistical tools, or quality-management and ERP systems. - QEHS experience in manufacturing, particularly chemicals or composites. - Experience with environmental permits, authorities, supplier quality, customer audits or new-product development. - Previous supervisory or team-leadership experience. **WHAT WE OFFER**We offer a varied, hands-on role where you can make a tangible impact on quality, safety and environmental performance at our Mäntyharju site. Working with advanced composite technologies in an international environment, you will collaborate across functions and locations to improve production processes and everyday practices. Your responsibilities will span operational improvement, management systems, audits and stakeholder cooperation, with scope to shape the role around your skills and experience.**INTERESTED?** We look forward to receiving your application and CV, including your salary expectations, by November 22, 2026.

jobs.title: Personlig assistent
jobs.description: **HITTA ETT MENINGSFULLT JOBB SOM PERSONLIG ASSISTENT**Vill du göra meningsfullt arbete och samtidigt själv påverka var, när och hur mycket du arbetar?På Assistanskliniken har jobbsökandet gjorts enkelt. **Ladda ner appen Assistanskliniken,** skapa din assistentprofil och hitta jobb som personlig assistent som passar dig direkt i mobilen.Det är du som väljer vilka jobbmöjligheter som intresserar dig.**Vad kan arbetet som personlig assistent innebära?**Som personlig assistentgör du det möjligt för kunden att leva en vardag på sina egna villkor. Du hjälper kunden med sådant som kunden själv skulle göra om det inte fanns ett hjälpbehov på grund av en funktionsnedsättning eller funktionsbegränsning. Kunden bestämmer själv i vilka frågor och på vilket sätt hjälp behövs.Arbetet kan till exempel innebärahjälp med vardagssysslor, matlagning, ärenden, förflyttning, studier, arbete, hobbyer eller fritidoch mycket mer. Varje kund och varje uppdrag är olika, så även assistentens arbetsdagar kan se mycket olika ut.**Det viktigaste är att kunden med assistentens stöd kan leva så självständigt som möjligt och enligt sina egna val.****Vem passar arbetet för?**Vi söker olika människor för olika kunder.Vi värdesätter framför alltpålitlighet, en god attityd och en vilja att hjälpa en annan människa. Tidigare erfarenhet av assistentarbete är en fördel, men inget krav.Arbetet passar både dig som söker regelbundet arbete och dig som söker enstaka arbetspass.**Varför Assistanskliniken?**Hos oss kan du själv påverka vilken typ av jobb du vill göra.Du ser jobbmöjligheter som passar dig direkt i appen Du bestämmer själv vilka jobb du är intresserad av Det finns olika arbetstider och kunder att välja mellan Du får stöd av teamet på Assistanskliniken Vi ger dig en introduktion till arbetetAssistanskliniken är ett finländskt företag inom personlig assistans. I vårt team arbetar också personer som själva har en funktionsnedsättning och utvecklar våra tjänster utifrån användarnas perspektiv. Vårt mål är att göra personlig assistans så smidig som möjligt för både kunden och assistenten.**Så här kommer du igång**1. Ladda ner appen Assistansklinikenfrån App Store eller Google Play. 2. Skapa ett **assistentkonto** och fyll i din profil noggrant. 3. Hitta jobbmöjligheter som passar dig. 4. Anmäl ditt intresse för ett jobb som passar dig. 5. Om du blir vald som kundens assistent kontaktar vi dig och ordnar tillsammans avtal, utdrag ur straffregistret, introduktion och allt annat praktiskt som behövs. **Det har aldrig varit så enkelt att få jobb. Hitta ett jobb som passar dig i appen Assistanskliniken!****Frågor?**Kontakta Evelina Kaisto, 044 7571637, evelina.kaisto@assistanskliniken.fi

Osallistut johtoryhmän jäsenenä yrityksen strategiatyöhön ja vastaat kasvuun liittyvien strategisten kokonaisuuksien edistämisestä.**Tehtävässä:**- johdat neljän hengen myyntitiimiä ja osallistut itse aktiivisesti myyntityöhön, asiakastapaamisiin ja kaupallisiin neuvotteluihin - vastaat aktiivisesta uusasiakashankinnasta ja uusien yritysasiakkuuksien rakentamisesta - vastaat myynnin tavoitteellisesta kehittämisestä, kannattavasta kasvusta ja asiakastyytyväisyydestä - viet palvelu- ja tuotekehitystä systemaattisempaan suuntaan ja kehität tapoja muuttaa teknistä osaamista selkeiksi, monistettaviksi ja kaupallisesti kannattaviksi ratkaisuiksi - kehität tarjouslaskentaa, konseptisuunnittelua ja tarjousten muodostamista yhdessä asiantuntijoiden kanssa - kehität myynnin, tarjouslaskennan, hinnoittelun ja tuotehallinnan prosesseja sujuvammiksi ja tehokkaammiksi - varmistat, että ERP-järjestelmä tukee käytännön myyntityötä, tuotehallintaa ja hinnastojen hallintaa mahdollisimman hyvin Tehtävässä menestyy parhaiten henkilö, jolla on vahva tekninen ymmärrys (polttomoottorit /koneenrakennus /huoltotoiminnot) sekä kaupallinen draivi. Tunnistat kasvumahdollisuuksia, rakennat luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita ja osaat viedä myyntiprosessia tavoitteellisesti eteenpäin. Ymmärrät myös, miten tarjouslaskenta, hinnoittelu, tuotteistaminen ja toimivat prosessit vaikuttavat myynnin onnistumiseen ja liiketoiminnan kannattavuuteen.**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**- vahvaa teknistä osaamista ja kykyä hahmottaa teknisiä kokonaisuuksia - kokemusta B2B-myynnistä, suurasiakkuuksista tai teknisestä ratkaisumyynnistä. Kokemus B2C-myynnistä katsotaan eduksi. - kokemusta prosessien, palveluiden tai tuotteiden kehittämisestä ja kaupallistamisesta - osaamista nykyaikaisten markkinointikanavien hyödyntämisestä - hyviä johtamistaitoja ja kykyä saada tiimi onnistumaan yhteisten tavoitteiden saavuttamisessa - analyyttistä ja kehittävää työotetta sekä ymmärrystä liiketoiminnan tunnusluvuista - rohkeutta tarttua toimeen, tehdä päätöksiä ja viedä asioita eteenpäin myös silloin, kun valmista toimintamallia ei vielä ole - suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa **Miksi tämä tehtävä on kiinnostava?**Tammer Dieselillä saat vastuullisen työtehtävän johtoryhmän jäsenenä, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten myydään, mitä asiakkaille tarjotaan ja miten tulevaisuuden kasvua rakennetaan. Saat keskeisen roolin strategisessa työssä ja toimit tiiviisti myös hallituksen kanssa. Työsuhde-etuihin kuuluu kattava vakuutus, liikunta– ja lounasetu sekä huollot ja varaosat henkilökuntahintaan. Asiakkaat sijaitsevat pääosin Suomessa, joten tehtävässä pääset tapaamaan asiakkaita ja tekemään yhteistyötä heidän kanssaan ilman jatkuvaa matkustamista. Asiakastyö onnistuu pääosin päivämatkoilla.Jos liiketoiminnan vahvistaminen, myynti, tuote- ja palvelukehitys sekä sisäisäisten prosessien määrätietoinen kehittäminen kuulostavat sinun paikaltasi, niin jätäthän hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian mutta viimeistään 17.11.2026. Du kommer til at arbejde alene i køkkenet og skal derfor være tryg ved selvstændigt at planlægge og udføre dagens opgaver. Maden tilberedes ud fra en fastlagt menu/madplan, og du står for hele processen fra madlavning til oprydning og rengøring.

Vikariatet løber i første omgang fra 9. november til 18. december 2026, men der er rigtig gode muligheder for forlængelse i flere måneder eller længere.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Tilberedning af daglige måltider til ca. 60 børn ud fra en fastlagt madplan.

  • Selvstændigt ansvar for den daglige drift af køkkenet.

  • Klargøring og forberedelse af råvarer og måltider.

  • Sikre god hygiejne og korrekt håndtering af fødevarer.

  • Opvask, oprydning og rengøring af køkkenet.

  • Øvrige praktiske køkkenopgaver efter behov.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har erfaring med madlavning, gerne fra institutionskøkken, kantine eller storkøkken.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og er vant til at tage ansvar.

  • Kan tilberede mad til større grupper ud fra en menu eller madplan.

  • Har kendskab til fødevarehygiejne og egenkontrol.

  • Har gode danskkundskaber.

  • Er mødestabil, struktureret og grundig.

  • Kan starte mandag den 9. november 2026.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et vikariat i en børneinstitution på Østerbro.

  • En selvstændig stilling med ansvar for køkkenet.

  • Gode muligheder for forlængelse i flere måneder eller længere.

  • Et godt samarbejde og løbende kontakt med FIRMAVIKAR.

Praktiske oplysninger

Arbejdssted: Østerbro, København ØOpstart: Mandag den 9. november 2026Varighed: Frem til 18. december 2026 i første omgang, med stor mulighed for forlængelseAnsættelsesform: Tidsbegrænset vikariat

Ansøgning

Har du erfaring med madlavning til større grupper, og kan du arbejde selvstændigt i et køkken? Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send dit CV og gerne en kort beskrivelse af din erfaring til job@firmavikar.dk.

Skriv "Køkkenmedhjælper Østerbro" i emnefeltet.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ønsker at finde den rette kandidat hurtigst muligt.

jobs.title: Keikkalaiseksi Riihitien palvelukotiin Liperiin (lähihoitaja, sosionomi, sairaanhoitaja)
jobs.description: Etsitkö joustavaa ja elämääsi sopivaa tapaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä? Me Honkalampi-säätiössä haemme nyt keikkalaisia **ohjaajan tehtäviin** Liperiin, Riihitien palvelukotiin. Taustaltasi voit olla esimerkiksi lääkeluvallinen**lähihoitaja, sosionomi tai sairaanhoitaja.**Riihitien palvelukoti tarjoaa ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista tukea tarvitseville aikuisille, joiden tuen tarpeen taustalla on esimerkiksi kehitysvamma. Meillä jokaisen arki rakentuu osallisuudesta, turvallisuudesta ja oikeudesta elää oman näköistä elämää. Huolehdimme turvallisesta ympäristöstä, jossa vuorovaikutus ja monipuoliset kommunikaation keinot ovat keskiössä. Haluamme, että kotimme on paikka, jossa jokainen tulee kuulluksi, ymmärretyksi ja kohdatuksi omana itsenään. jobs.title: Client Accounting Division Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Burkland's core purpose is to Accelerate Dreams. So often, turning dreams into reality helps change the world. We thrive at the forefront of this transformation. Startups desire our professionals as they are the best in the business. Startups seek our content because we are an industry thought leader. Startups trust our expertise, so founders can focus on their companies, products, and value-add. Because of our demonstrated value, our clients have raised more than $17.8B!

At Burkland, we lead with our Core Purpose. We do this for both our clients and our employees. We believe that leaning on our Core Values (Fresh Perspectives, Exponential Value, Empathy, Trusted Partner) will lead to happy clients and happy employees.

We are a remote-first company with over 185 team members, more than 800 clients, and a culture built on doing meaningful work with people who genuinely care about helping our clients grow. Come build something with us!


Role Summary

The Client Accounting Division Manager runs their division as a self-contained business unit within Burkland. The role owns the division's P&L and staffing, and is accountable not only for its own scorecard but for the aggregate performance of every KPI held by roles within the division. Success is measured by both business and people outcomes: revenue, margin, utilization, service quality, and client retention, alongside the growth and engagement of the people doing the work. The division supports consumer and product-based startups, so the manager brings deep inventory and cost accounting expertise to guide the teamâs technical work and client advice.

This is a hands-on people leadership role. The manager is expected to understand strengths and development needs of each team member in their business unit, set clear expectations, give consistent feedback, address performance issues early, and build a team that can deliver both accounting and proactive advisory work at a high standard. The manager also owns key client relationships and serves as the first-line escalation point for client issues, with a defined handoff path for anything beyond their resolution.

This job description outlines the core of the role, but it isn't meant to cover everything you'll do. As Burkland grows, your responsibilities may shift and new projects, tasks, or priorities may be added along the way. We hope you'll see that as a chance to stretch, learn, and broaden your contributions.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Division Performance and KPI Accountability

  • Own the business unit's P&L, including revenue, margin, and utilization targets.

  • Drive aggregate performance across all KPIs assigned to Accounting Associates and Client Accounting Advisors, in addition to the manager's own scorecard.

  • Track division performance regularly, identify gaps early, and take corrective action at the individual and team level.

  • Report on division results to the Director of Accounting Advisory, including risks, trends, and planned actions.

  • Manage capacity and workload distribution across the division as well as assigning clients.

  • Contribute to pricing and fixed-fee scoping, and monitor engagement profitability.

  • Maintain awareness of AR and collections for division clients and address issues with the appropriate teams.

People Leadership and Staffing

  • Set clear role expectations and performance goals tied to the KPIs each team member owns.

  • Lead regular, structured 1:1s focused on goals, workload, development, and wellbeing, not only status updates. Use them to give direct, ongoing feedback that recognizes strong work and addresses gaps as they appear, rather than waiting for review cycles.

  • Create clear growth plans and provide ongoing coaching to develop each team member, in partnership with the Director and People Team

  • Conduct performance reviews, manage performance concerns directly, and contribute to compensation and promotion recommendations.

  • Monitor team capacity and engagement to support retention and prevent burnout.

  • Apply company policies consistently, manage time-off and leave requests, and bring performance concerns, employee relations matters, and escalations to the Director and People Team for guidance and resolution.

  • Plan staffing against current and forecasted client demand and build the business case for new headcount.

  • Lead hiring for the division through interviewing and selection, and onboard new team members so they reach full productivity within expected timelines.

Inventory Accounting and Technical Oversight

  • Oversee inventory valuation, reconciliation, and physical and cycle count processes across the divisionâs client portfolio, making sure variances are investigated and resolved quickly.

  • Set standards for costing methods (FIFO, LIFO, weighted average) and ensure the team applies them correctly by client and industry.

  • Ensure the team delivers accurate GAAP financial statements, inventory reporting, and COGS and gross margin analysis tailored to each clientâs business model.

  • Guide ERP and inventory software implementations, migrations, and improvements (partnering with ERP specialist where needed), and ensure client records stay audit-ready (as appropriate for the engagement size and scope).

  • Coach the team to help clients reduce shrinkage, obsolescence, overstocking, and stockouts, and to improve working capital through metrics like inventory turnover and days on hand.

  • Strong understanding of supply chain methods such as contract manufacturing and 3PL operations

Client Relationships and Service Quality

  • Act as an escalation point for client relationship issues.

  • Oversee quality control to ensure deliverables meet firm standards.

  • Shift the team's work from solely report delivery toward proactive advisory.

Growth and Operations

  • Own growth of the division's book of business through business development efforts to expand existing client relationships and identify service-expansion opportunities

  • Maintain accurate, current portfolio information in Knownwell

  • Drive full adoption of firm tools, systems, and processes, including AI-enabled workflows

Group and Company Success

A One Burkland mindset:

Our clients are best served when teams work together, not in silos. Partner closely with Tax, CFO, HR, and other service lines to create consistency, share knowledge, and deliver a seamless client experience across Burkland.

  • Comfort with an increasing pace of change:

Today's pace is the slowest we will experience going forward, not a finish line before things settle. As AI and related tools evolve, our processes evolve with them. This allows for more chances to learn, grow, and shape how the work gets done.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI-driven efficiency:

Proactively look for smarter ways of working as new tools come online. This is about changing how the work gets done, not reducing the need for skilled people to do it.

  • A constructive attitude:

Attitude is contagious in both directions, across the team and with clients. Approach change with curiosity and enthusiasm. Help to set that tone for others rather than defaulting to resistance.

  • Full adoption of firm tools and processes:

Systems are critical to growth and often fail to be effective when only part of the team uses them well.

  • Delivery and proactive advisory:

Build real understanding of where each client's business is headed and advise ahead of it. Clients need the why behind their numbers, not just the numbers.

Core Competencies & Skills

  • Financial Acumen â cost management, margin analysis, fixed-fee scope adjustments, and AR/collections awareness.

  • Client Relationshipsâ Client relationship management, escalation handling, and spotting cross-sell and service-expansion opportunities.

  • Advisory mindset â Moving teams from report delivery alone to proactive advisory.

  • Leading Change â Champions of change, including AI-driven efficiency, leading by example in the consistent adoption of firm tools, systems and processes and reinforcing them across the team.

  • AI Fluency â Hands-on comfort using AI tools in accounting and operational work, with sound judgment about where AI adds value, where human review is required, and how to protect client data.

  • Cross-functional collaboration â Build strong working relationships across Service Delivery, partnering with other teams on shared client work and aligning with Growth on new client onboarding and cross-sell opportunities

  • Inventory and Cost Accounting Expertise â Deep knowledge of inventory accounting, costing methods, COGS, and GAAP, with the ability to guide a team through complex inventory work and system implementations. Strong understanding of supply chain methods such as contract manufacturing and 3PL operations as well as eCommerce operations and cash flows through Shopify, Amazon, eBay, and other marketplace solutions.

Minimum Requirements / Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, accounting, finance, or a related field, and 5+ years of progressive professional experience

  • Direct people management experience, including conducting performance reviews, managing underperformance, and developing team members

  • Exceptional client relationship management skills and the ability to understand client needs

  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, and deliver high-quality results

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, team members, and leadership

  • Curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and an eagerness to take on new challenges involving emerging technology and industries

  • Strong command of GAAP and cost accounting, including inventory accounting (FIFO, LIFO, landed costs, shrinkage, and valuation adjustments)

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA or CMA credential

  • Experience owning or significantly contributing to a team budget, P&L, or book of business

  • Prior experience leading a team within a professional services or client accounting environment

  • Hands-on ERP and inventory system experience (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Cin7, Fishbowl, or similar)

  • Experience leading or overseeing ERP or inventory software implementations

Â 

Physical & Environmental Demands

This is a remote position. Work is primarily performed at a computer for extended periods, requiring the ability to use a keyboard, view a screen, and communicate via video and phone. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EEO Statement

Burkland Associates is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Burkland Associates is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or another legally protected status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please visit our careers page https://burklandassociates.com/careers/. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment-qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

The base pay range target for the role described in this job description is 120,000-140,000. Final offer amounts depend on multiple factors such as candidate experience and expertise, geographic location, total compensation, and market data. In addition, full-time regular positions are eligible for, 401(k), health benefits, and other benefits; some of these benefits may be available for part-time.

jobs.title: MEHANIČAR/MEHANIČARKA- MEHATRONIČAR/MEHATRONIČARKA
jobs.description:
MEHANIČAR/MEHANIČARKA- MEHATRONIČAR/MEHATRONIČARKA

Kao obiteljsko poduzeće znamo da su ljudi ti, koji svojim znanjem i vještinama pridonose našem uspjehu. Isto im vraćamo sa stimulativnim primanjima i korporativnom kulturom u kojoj se žive obiteljske vrijednosti. Želimo biti više od skupine timova u jednom poduzeću. Međusobna suradnja znači za nas međusobnu povezanost. Svi smo složni u uvjerenju da zajedno postižemo velike stvari.

Kao poduzeće. Kao tim. Kao obitelj.

Očekuju te sljedeći zadaci:

  • Redovito održavanje strojeva u proizvodnom pogonu
  • Utvrđivanje i otklanjanje kvarova na strojevima
  • Izvođenje servisa, remonta i montaže strojeva
  • Briga o zalihi rezervnih dijelova
  • Godišnje provođenje ispitivanja elektro uređaja

Što donosiš sa sobom:

  • Završena škola: elektrotehničar, elektromehaničar, mehatroničar ili električar, stručnjak za pneumatiku i hidrauliku
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo minimalno 2 godine u području održavanja pneumatskih i hidrauličnih strojeva
  • Pouzdanost i samostalnost u obavljanju radnih zadataka
  • Izraženi timski duh
  • Fleksibilnost
  • Poželjno poznavanje engleskog ili njemačkog jezika u govoru i pismu

Što te očekuje:

  • Rad u internacionalnom okruženju
  • Stimulativna primanja
  • Mogućnost napredovanja
  • Ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme
  • Poticajna i prijateljska radna atmosfera
  • Uvođenje u posao pod vodstvom mentora
  • Dvosmjenski rad
  • Vrhunska oprema i postrojenje
  • Veliki benefit paket (npr. team building, božićni domjenak, sportske aktivnosti, osiguranje 0-24, uplata u 3. mirovinski stup i još mnoge pogodnosti)

jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10,105/10-ispr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ te čl. 7. Pravilnika o radu OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“, ravnateljica Osnovne škole-Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“ Rijeka, Mirka Čurbega 18, objavljuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjenje radnog mjesta
  • 1 stručni suradnik/stručna suradnica – pedagog/pedagoginja na talijanskom jeziku na određeno i puno radno vrijeme (zamjena) uz uvjet probnog rada prema odredbama Temeljnog kolektivnog ugovora za službenike i namještenike u javnim službama
TRAŽENI UVJETI: 1. Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12., 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17 i 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno čl. 29., st. 1. a) Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN br. 6/19, 75/20):
  • završen sveučilišni diplomski studij
  • potpuno vladanje talijanskim jezikom i pismom
2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.). Na oglašena radna mjesta mogu se javiti osobe oba spola, sukladno čl. 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/16, 69/17). Svi izrazi korišteni u natječaju odnose se na osobe oba spola. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti:
  • životopis (CV) sastavljen na hrvatskom i na talijanskom jeziku,
  • presliku diplome, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog natječaja.
Navedenu dokumentaciju potrebno je dostaviti neposredno ili poštom preporučeno na adresu škole, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave ovog natječaja na mrežnoj stranici Škole i mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, provjera poznavanja talijanskog jezika za kandidate koji nisu završili najmanje jedan obrazovni ciklus na talijanskom jeziku, sastav motivacijskog pisma i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici škole, te na mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje dana 2. studenog 2026. godine. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull’educazione e l’istruzione nella scuola primaria e secondaria (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione e ai sensi dell'articolo 7 del Regolamento interno per l'assunzione del personale della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”, la direttrice della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò” di Fiume, Via Mirko Čurbeg 18, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per il posto di lavoro
  • 1 collaboratore/collaboratrice professionale – pedagogista in lingua italiana – orario completo, a tempo determinato (supplenza) con la condizione del periodo di prova secondo il Contratto collettivo essenziale per gli ufficiali negli enti pubblici
CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE: 1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull’educazione e l’istruzione nella scuola primaria e secondaria (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformita' all'articolo 29, comma 1 a) del Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19, 75/20):
  • laurea
  • padronanza della lingua e della scrittura italiana
2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione:
  • dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana,
  • il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova di cittadinanza,
  • il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e
  • l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso).
La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, consegnata personalmente o spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 2 novembre 2026.

jobs.title: PRODAJNI/A SAVJETNIK/CA – PRODAJA SOLARNIH ELEKTRANA
jobs.description: TERENSKI/A PRODAJNI/A PREDSTAVNIK/CA ZA SOLARNE ELEKTRANE Green Bean traži prodajnu osobu za aktivno pronalaženje kupaca solarnih elektrana, prvenstveno vlasnika obiteljskih kuća. Kako izgleda posao? Glavninu rada čine terenski obilasci sela i manjih mjesta u okolici Zagreba. Obilazite dodijeljeno područje, neposredno pristupate vlasnicima kuća i započinjete razgovore o mogućnosti ugradnje solarne elektrane. Važan dio posla čine kontakti bez prethodno dogovorenog sastanka. Očekujemo da samostalno stvarate nove prodajne prilike te zainteresirane kupce pratite od prvog razgovora do ugovaranja. Glavni poslovi: • planiranje i obilazak dodijeljenog područja • osobno kontaktiranje vlasnika kuća i predstavljanje ponude • prepoznavanje interesa i prikupljanje podataka potrebnih za izradu ponude • dogovaranje daljnjih sastanaka i tehničkih obilazaka • prezentacija ponuda te redoviti telefonski, e-mail i osobni kontakt s kupcima do njihove odluke • vođenje evidencije kontakata i prodajnih aktivnosti • suradnja s tehničkim i operativnim timom Koga tražimo? Osobu kojoj odgovara svakodnevni teren, koja može samostalno započeti razgovor s nepoznatom osobom i ustrajno pratiti prodajne prilike. Važno nam je kako pristupate kupcu, slušate njegove potrebe i postupate nakon odbijanja. Prednost imaju kandidati s dokazivim iskustvom u samostalnom pronalaženju i pridobivanju novih kupaca, osobito kroz neposrednu terensku prodaju. Iskustvo sa solarnim elektranama ili tehničkim proizvodima predstavlja prednost, ali nije uvjet. Osiguravamo edukaciju o solarnim elektranama i našem prodajnom procesu. jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect (f/m/d)  IT/OT Security Platforms (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description: Together, we make the differenceSiemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.As a Solution Architect (f/m/d) for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts.As part of our team, you will have- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interestsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.What part will you play?- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements. - You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases. - You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints. - You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps. - You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens. - You define integration concepts between connectivity services, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems. - You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape. - You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability. - You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.What you bring to the table- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification. - Experience & Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443. - You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures. - You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps. - You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design. - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- Ways of working:- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments. - You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).- Languages: Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usWe know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority.Our global,diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/) – if you need further information on the application process.
