jobs.title: Productization Specialist
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Productization Specialist / Product Lifecycle Engineer to join a New Product Introduction (NPI) team responsible for bringing new products successfully from development into production.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

In this role, you will act as a key link between R&D, production, sales, and business operations, ensuring that new products, features, and solutions are implemented efficiently and according to agreed processes. You will play an important role in developing productization practices, supporting projects, and helping the organization scale new products into successful business.

Key Responsibilities:
 Coordinate the implementation of new products into production
 Develop and maintain productization concepts and best practices
 Support R&D, production, and sales throughout different project phases
 Ensure adherence to agreed business processes and transfer-to-business procedures
 Gather and specify requirements for new functionalities and process improvements
 Participate in testing and validation activities

What Were Looking For:
 B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Engineering or a related field
 Minimum 2 years of experience in productization, NPI, manufacturing engineering, or a similar role
 Understanding of electronics and software product development environments

 Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills

- Do you have experience using Azure DevOps or similar lifecycle management tools?*
- Have you participated in testing, validation, or implementation activities for new products or processes?*

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role.

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Electronics Engineering or a related field
- Minimum 2 years of experience as an Electronics Designer, Component Engineer, or in a similar role

 Digital components (microprocessors, FPGAs, memories)
 Analog components (A/D converters, amplifiers, switches)
 Discrete components (transistors, diodes, resistors, capacitors)
 Electromechanical components (connectors, cables, cooling solutions)
 Transformers and magnetic components
 Optical components

jobs.title: Marketing Automation Specialists
jobs.description:
We are looking for two experienced Marketing Automation Specialists for our client in the banking sector.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

Detailed description of work task to be carried out:
Marketing automation activities to drive business KPIs, e.g. product sales targets for PeB FI. Backfill specialists gone for longer leave / job rotation.

Must-have knowledge and experience:
 You most likely have a Masters degree in economics, finance, mathematics, technology, statistics, marketing, or similar
 You have documented experience (> 2 years) with omni-channel campaign building in Marketing Automation solutions such as Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Campaign, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, SAS 360/Marketing Automation, or similar
 Experience with Data Science and web analytics and use of various tools such as PowerBI, Adobe Analytics, CJA, and/or GA
 Preferably, you have experience working in Agile teams or SAFe, but this is not a requirement
 Strong communication skills in English, ideally also in Finnish

Nice-to-have knowledge and experience:
 Finance industry
 Presentation skills
 Project Management skill

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have at least 2 years of documented, hands-on experience working with marketing automation platforms such as Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Campaign, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, SAS 360 or similar?*
- Do you have practical experience independently building and executing omnichannel marketing campaigns, including customer journeys, segmentation and personalized communications?*
- Do you have hands-on experience with data analysis, web analytics and tools such as Power BI, Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) or Google Analytics?*
- Do you hold a Masters degree in economics, finance, mathematics, technology, statistics, marketing or a related field? *
- Are you fluent in English, both written and spoken, and able to communicate effectively with business and technical stakeholders?*

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role.

Allocation: 100 %
Assignment start date: 4.1.2027
Assignment end date: 14.1.2028
Location: Helsinki, Finland
Language: Fluent in English, both written and spoken

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application! 

Please include your salary expectation in your application. For more information, contact Kimmo Kärsämä, tel. 050 412 7500, kimmo.karsama@lokki.fi

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.description:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

jobs.title: Køkkenchef, India Spice – Fuldtid
jobs.description:
India Spice is a passionate Indian restaurant and catering kitchen with a deep love for rich flavors, authentic spices, and traditional culinary craftsmanship.

We are best known for our vibrant North and South Indian specialties, aromatic curries, andtandoor dishes, but most importantly, we believe in making authentic food from scratch,using fresh, high-quality ingredients and taking pride in the tradition behind everything we serve.

For us, India Spice is about more than serving great meals. It is about warm hospitality, creating memorable dining experiences, and treating our guests, team members, and partners with respect. We are an ambitious, growing business, but we also want India Spice to be a workplace where people take pride in what they do, enjoy coming to work, and feel a shared responsibility for our quality and standards.

Currently, our operations cover our busy restaurant service, takeaway, and event catering, and we are looking for the right person to take responsibility for the day-to-day organization and operational flow of our kitchen.

About the position

As our Kitchen Manager, you will play a central role in keeping the kitchen structured, efficient, and running smoothly across daily prep, restaurant service, and catering orders.

Key Responsibilities:

• Overall coordination and operational organization of the kitchen

• Maintaining strict hygiene and food safety standards according to Danish Fødevarestyrelsen regulations

• Staff scheduling and daily task delegation for kitchen and prep staff

• Overseeing kitchen maintenance, ensuring equipment, tandoors, and workstations remain clean and in peak condition

• Purchasing, ordering ingredients, spices, packaging, and operational supplies

• Inventory management and stock control to ensure availability for high-volume weekends and large catering orders

• Establishing clear prep routines, portion control, and workflow improvements as our catering demands expand

• Collaborating closely with our chefs and front-of-house team to ensure consistent food quality and punctual service

Qualifications & Qualities:

• Experience working in a professional kitchen, catering operation, or food production environment is an advantage, but having the right mindset is what matters most.

• You are structured, dependable, and punctual, with natural ownership over your responsibilities.

• You are proactive, notice details quickly, and thrive when bringing order and smooth routines to a fast-paced environment.

• You communicate clearly and comfortably in English (Danish is a plus, but not required).

Practical Information

• Position: Kitchen Manager

• Hours: Full-time (37 hours per week)

• Location: Søborg Hovedgade 118, 2860 Søborg

• Salary: Competitive, based on qualifications and experience

• Start Date: As soon as possible / By agreement

How to apply

Send your application and CV to info@indiaspice.dk with the subject line "Application: Kitchen Manager – India Spice".

If you have any questions regarding the role or India Spice, feel free to contact us at info@indiaspice.dk.

We review applications continuously and look forward to hearing from you — and hopefully welcoming you to the India Spice family.

Support Engineer I (FC, Weekend Shift)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Support Engineer you are at the forefront of helping those developers create. In a given day you’ll help folks with all sorts of things ranging from general Replit usage questions, identifying and debugging issues on the platform and helping to build and maintain the tools we use. We use tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and Replit itself to get the job done. We also value solving the problems we can ourselves. We have a number of tools we build and maintain ourselves.



You will work on a small, global team of support specialists and engineers united by Replit's mission to make the next billion software creators. Together, you'll ensure developers worldwide have the support they need to bring their ideas to life.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Work directly with Replit customers via support tickets to solve technical product issues, bugs, and provide technical guidance while meeting daily ticket volume and resolution time targets.

 - Collaborate with the rest of the Support team in telling the story of our users to the rest of Replit.

 - Directly contribute to and maintain the Support team's Knowledge Base.

 - Support customer-facing communications for outages and incidents and swiftly report ongoing bugs for Eng to triage and fix.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Prior experience in software development or relevant technical support experience

 - Proven ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, high-volume support environments with strict productivity metrics.

 - Strong time management and ticket triage skills with comfort in performance tracking and regular reporting.

 - Excellent communication skills with initiative to ask questions when encountered with the unknown.

 - Experience with support tools and ticketing systems (e.g. Zendesk)




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

 - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The schedule follows a Saturday through Wednesday work week, with an in-office requirement on Mondays and Wednesdays.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Manager, Commercial Outcome Architects (Customer Success)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are looking for a proven Outcomes Architects Manager with a strategic and entrepreneurial spirit to join the GTM Team. As the Commercial OA Leader, you will play an important role defining/iterating on our expand motions, providing customer feedback to help share our roadmap, driving increased adoption, owning ongoing value delivery, and and generating expansion revenue to grow our business. You will own the strategy and execution of your team’s segment.

The Outcomes Architect team is a new function at Notion that combines RM, CSM and SE capabilities to drive workflow adoption and retention at our customers.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Increase Team Performance on Adoption, Retention, and Customer Value: Your role centers on up-leveling the team to boost product adoption, retention, customer value, and satisfaction through effective retention strategies and churn prevention in the Commercial segment (note that your team will own a subset of renewals).

 - Team Leadership and Development: As a leader, you'll recruit, train, and mentor a high-performing Outcomes Architect team that embodies our core values and operational goals.

 - Data-Driven Insights and Operational Excellence: You will build and refine a consistent KPI/OKR system that enables data-driven decisions to identify risks, trends, and opportunities.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration and Partnerships: You will partner with solutions consulting and forward deployed engineers to ensure smooth customer onboarding and continuously refine the customer journey to drive long-term success. You will also bridge the gap between customers and internal teams by channeling feedback into product development, ensuring continuous improvement of the platform.

 - AI Workflow Adoption: You and your team will drive new workflows and build beside customers to implement them.

 - Customer Leadership: You will serve as the key extension of your team for high-stakes customer engagements (both internally and externally), such as business reviews.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of people management experience for a CS, sales, SE or account management team

 - Experience with large and strategic customers (experience with Fortune 500)

 - Experience working with technical stakeholders

 - Experience driving AI adoption

 - Can convey complex information to executives clearly and concisely and resolve tradeoffs

jobs.title: Directeur multisites - H/F (H/F)
jobs.description: Notre client est un groupe familial d'hôteliers passionnés, présent en France depuis plus de 50 ans, exploitant une 10aine d'établissements, sous franchise ou en marque propre. Animé par des valeurs de Responsabilité, d'Audace, de Respect et d'Excellence, le groupe place l'expérience client au cœur de ses priorités et poursuit son développement avec l'ambition d'offrir une qualité de service constante « dans l'exceptionnel comme dans le traditionnel ». Nous recherchons pour leur combo situé à Montpellier, leur futur : Directeur multisites - H/F- CDI - Statut Cadre Autonome- Basé à Montpellier- Nombreux avantages Vos motivations :Vous souhaitez diriger un véritable lieu de vie, réunissant deux établissements au cœur de Montpellier et accueillant une clientèle diversifiée.Vous êtes motivé par l'opportunité d'accompagner la montée en gamme du site, de piloter les travaux associés et de mettre à profit votre excellente compréhension des enjeux opérationnels.Vous recherchez un établissement proposant une offre complète, avec des activités F&B, séminaires et bar, et présentant un réel potentiel de développement commercial.Vous appréciez les fonctions de Direction dans lesquelles la commercialisation occupe une place centrale, notamment dans un contexte de repositionnement et de montée en gamme. Vous privilégiez également les fonctions de Direction résolument opérationnelles, au plus près des équipes et des réalités du terrain. Enfin, vous êtes à l'aise dans l'environnement d'un groupe familial et appréciez de travailler aux côtés de véritables hôteliers, experts et passionnés.Vos missions : Expérience client : Développer et maintenir une expérience client en adéquation aux valeurs de la marque. Suivre le déroulement du séjour des clients. Veiller à améliorer en permanence l'expérience client en identifiant les points d'amélioration. Gérer les situations de conflit ou d'insatisfaction de la clientèle. Assurer le suivi de la e-réputation en apportant les réponses à chaque commentaire client.Développement commercial : En collaboration avec le siège, élaborer ou appliquer une politique commerciale pour atteindre le CA budgété. Entretenir des relations commerciales productives en interne et en externe. Analyser le marché et la concurrence locale. Contrôler et évaluer la qualité du service rendu. Fixer le prix des prestations.Management et animation d'équipe : Coordonner et animer le travail de toutes les équipes de l'hôtel. Évaluer les compétences nécessaires à la qualité du service, les recruter. Superviser l'ensemble des activités de l'hôtel, soit en direct, soit par délégation auprès de ses chefs de service. S'appuyer sur les compétences internes tout en assurant la responsabilité finale.Gestion & Performance : Contrôler et évaluer la performance & rentabilité de l'établissement (gestion des comptes d'exploitation, pricing, TO, marge,). Optimiser les coûts en respectant le budget annuel validé. Élaborer et exploiter des tableaux de bord de suivi de l'activité. Mettre en place ou utiliser des outils de reporting. jobs.title: LEDIG STILLING- ØKONOMIANSVARLIG – BEBOERØKONOMI
jobs.description:
Vil du bidra til en trygg og forsvarlig økonomisk oppfølging av beboerne våre?

Voss ordinære asylmottak søker en strukturert, nøyaktig og ansvarsbevisst økonomiansvarlig med hovedansvar for beboerøkonomi og refusjonskrav til Utlendingsdirektoratet (UDI).

Hva vi ser etter

Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ønsker at du har:

  • Utdanning innen økonomi, regnskap eller administrasjon. Relevant erfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning.

  • God tallforståelse og gode ferdigheter i Excel.

  • Gode digitale ferdigheter.

  • Evne til å arbeide strukturert og håndtere flere oppgaver samtidig.

  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig.

  • Evne til å håndtere konfidensiell informasjon på en trygg og profesjonell måte.

Erfaring med økonomiadministrasjon, refusjonskrav, dokumentasjonsarbeid eller arbeid ved asylmottak vil være en fordel. Kjennskap til UDIs regelverk og rutiner for økonomiske ytelser og refusjoner er ønskelig.

Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Møter alle beboere med respekt, verdighet og forståelse, uavhengig av bakgrunn og livssituasjon.

  • Er rolig, tålmodig og behersket, også i utfordrende situasjoner.

  • Håndterer stress og arbeider effektivt under press.

  • Er nøyaktig, strukturert og ansvarsbevisst.

  • Har høy integritet og behandler fortrolige opplysninger med diskresjon.

  • Arbeider selvstendig og tar initiativ innenfor eget ansvarsområde.

  • Er løsningsorientert og håndterer uforutsette situasjoner på en profesjonell måte.

  • Har gode samarbeidsevner og kommuniserer tydelig og respektfullt med både beboere og kolleger.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgaver

1. Beboerøkonomi

  • Administrere og følge opp beboernes økonomiske ytelser.

  • Beregne og kontrollere utbetalinger i henhold til gjeldende satser og retningslinjer.

  • Sørge for korrekt og rettidig utbetaling av økonomiske ytelser.

  • Registrere og dokumentere alle utbetalinger.

  • Kontrollere utbetalingslister, kvitteringer og økonomiske bilag.

  • Følge opp endringer i beboernes situasjon som påvirker økonomiske ytelser.

  • Utarbeide oversikter og rapporter knyttet til beboerøkonomi.

2. Refusjonskrav til UDI

  • Utarbeide, kontrollere og sende refusjonskrav til UDI i henhold til gjeldende rutiner og frister.

  • Kontrollere at utgifter som kreves refundert, er dokumentert og oppfyller gjeldende vilkår.

  • Sikre at nødvendig dokumentasjon, bilag og kvitteringer vedlegges refusjonskravene.

  • Følge opp innsendte refusjonskrav og eventuelle spørsmål eller tilbakemeldinger fra UDI.

  • Registrere og følge opp godkjente, avslåtte og utestående refusjonskrav.

  • Bidra til god intern økonomikontroll og korrekt rapportering av refusjonsberettigede utgifter.

3. Generelle administrative oppgaver

  • Sikre forsvarlig arkivering og behandling av økonomiske opplysninger.

  • Følge opp økonomiske avvik og bidra til gode interne kontrollrutiner.

  • Samarbeide tett med mottaksleder og øvrige ansatte.

  • Gi beboerne nødvendig informasjon om økonomiske ytelser og utbetalingsrutiner.

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr

  • En meningsfull stilling i et viktig samfunnsoppdrag.

  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver med et tydelig ansvarsområde.

  • Et inkluderende og engasjert arbeidsmiljø.

  • Muligheten til å bidra til god økonomisk forvaltning og forsvarlig drift av mottaket.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Lilandtunet AS

Lilandtunet AS er et norsk selskap med base i Voss, Vestland. Selskapet har bakgrunn fra hotell- og gjestfrihetsbransjen, men har tilpasset sin virksomhet til å tilby innkvartering for asylsøkere.

I dag driver Lilandtunet AS Voss ordinære asylmottak på oppdrag fra Utlendingsdirektoratet (UDI), gjennom en inngått driftsavtale. Selskapet er opptatt av å tilby trygge, verdige og forsvarlige boforhold, og å skape et inkluderende og godt miljø for beboerne, samtidig som virksomheten drives på en profesjonell og ansvarlig måte.

jobs.description: MELITEK IS HIRING MACHINE OPERATORS, Nørre Alslev, Denmark - ability to read and write Danish is a requirementJoin MELITEK as a Machine Operator:MELITEK is expanding its production team and looking for motivated production operators to join our modernmanufacturing facility in Nørre Alslev on Falster.THE POSITION AT A GLANCE:Location Nørre Alslev, Falster, DenmarkWorking hours Three 12-hour shifts per weekShift options Day shift 06:00-18:00 or night shift 18:00-06:00ABOUT THE ROLE:You will start as a Plastic Operator and receive individual, on-the-job training from experienced Machine Operators. jobs.title: Barchef søges til Sukiaba på toppen af det ikoniske Bella Sky
jobs.description:
Barchef – SUKAIBA

Vil du stå i spidsen for en af Københavns mest spektakulære cocktailbarer?

På toppen af Bella Sky finder du Restaurant Sukaiba – en Restaurant og Cocktail bar som er en del af Norrlyst Koncernen, hvor gastronomi, udsigt og atmosfære smelter sammen i en helstøbt gæsteoplevelse.

Her forenes asiatisk inspireret gastronomi med ambitiøse vin- og cocktailparringer og en professionel servicekultur, hvor kvalitet, kreativitet og værtskab går hånd i hånd.

Vi søger nu en passioneret og visionær Barchef, der vil tage ejerskab over vores cocktailbar og være med til at udvikle den til noget helt særligt. En fagligt stærk profil, der brænder for cocktails, værtskab og ledelse, og som kan skabe retning, engagement og høj kvalitet i baren.

ROLLEN

Som Barchef får du det overordnede ansvar for cocktailbarens daglige drift, udvikling og personale. Du bliver den faglige drivkraft bag baren og får en central rolle i at sætte standarden for både kvalitet, kreativitet og gæsteoplevelser.

Du arbejder i tæt samarbejde med Restaurantchefen og indgår som en vigtig del af restaurantens samlede ledelsesteam. Med reference til Restaurantchefen har du selvstændigt ansvar for cocktailbaren og dens medarbejdere.

Dine ansvarsområder omfatter:

  • Det overordnede ansvar for cocktailbarens daglige drift og performance

  • Ledelse, udvikling og motivation af barens bartendere

  • Rekruttering, onboarding og oplæring af nye medarbejdere i samarbejde med Restaurantchefen

  • Udvikling og løbende fornyelse af cocktailkortet med fokus på kreativitet, kvalitet og sæsonens råvarer

  • Sikring af høje faglige standarder inden for cocktails, præsentation og værtskab

  • Ansvar for barens indkøb, lagerstyring, vareforbrug og omkostningsoptimering

  • Udvikling af nye cocktailkoncepter og kreative drinksoplevelser

  • Sikring af struktur, arbejdsrutiner og effektive arbejdsgange bag baren

  • Tæt samarbejde med køkkenet og Restaurantchefen om vin- og cocktailparringer samt restaurantens samlede gæsteoplevelse

  • Aktiv deltagelse i driften, hvor du går forrest og viser vejen for dit team

Du er både en kreativ cocktailprofil og en stærk leder. Du formår at kombinere passionen for håndværket med struktur, økonomisk forståelse og evnen til at udvikle mennesker.

VI SØGER DIG, DER

  • Har minimum 3 års erfaring fra cocktail- eller restaurantbranchen

  • Har solid erfaring med cocktailhåndværk og en naturlig interesse for nye teknikker, smage og trends

  • Gerne har erfaring fra en lignende rolle som Barchef, Assistant Bar Manager eller Lead Bartender

  • Har erfaring med personaleledelse eller et naturligt talent for at motivere og udvikle andre

  • Har forståelse for økonomi, vareforbrug, lagerstyring og indkøb

  • Brænder for værtskab og for at skabe ekstraordinære gæsteoplevelser

  • Arbejder struktureret og tager naturligt ansvar for både kvalitet og drift

  • Er kreativ, initiativrig og ikke bange for at udfordre det eksisterende

  • Er en holdspiller med positiv energi og en professionel tilgang til samarbejde

Du har ambitioner på barens vegne og motiveres af at skabe noget, der skiller sig ud. Du går op i detaljen, men forstår samtidig betydningen af det store billede.

VI TILBYDER

  • En central lederstilling med selvstændigt ansvar for cocktailbaren

  • Mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på barens identitet, cocktailkort og udvikling

  • Stor kreativ frihed til at eksperimentere og udvikle nye cocktailoplevelser

  • Mulighed for at udvikle og forme dit eget barteam

  • Et tæt samarbejde med Restaurantchefen og resten af restaurantens ledelsesteam

  • En dynamisk og ambitiøs arbejdsplads med højt til loftet

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • En del af en kvalitetsdrevet koncern med stærke værdier og udviklingsmuligheder

  • Konkurrencedygtig lønpakke

HVORFOR VÆLGE SUKAIBA?

Hos Sukaiba er ambitionerne høje, men fællesskabet er mindst lige så vigtigt. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem engagement, gensidig respekt og en fælles passion for det, vi laver.

Vi ønsker at skabe en cocktailbar, hvor kreativitet, kvalitet og personlighed går hånd i hånd – og hvor både gæster og medarbejdere har lyst til at komme igen.

Vi er en del af Norrlyst Koncernen, hvor der er gode muligheder for sparring, udvikling og karriere på tværs af organisationen.

PRAKTISK

Stillingen er på fuld tid med opstart hurtigst muligt – men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - NLP
Lead Game Programmer
jobs.description:
Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.Here’s what that looks like day to day

  • In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

  • You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

  • You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs

  • You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

  • You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

  • Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

This includes things like...

  • Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

  • Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

  • Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

  • Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

  • Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

You’re a great match if

  • You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

  • You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

  • You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

  • You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

  • You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

Nice to haves

  • You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

  • Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

  • Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

  • Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

  • Experience building systemic or open-world games

What always matters to us at Triband

  • You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

  • You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

  • You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

  • You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

  • You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong

  • You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

Practicalities

  • We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

  • For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

  • We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

  • Our working language is English.

We offer

  • Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

  • A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

  • Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

  • A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

  • Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

  • Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

  • Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

  • Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

  • Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

  • Pension plan and private health insurance.

  • Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

WHAT THE TRIBAND?Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

jobs.title: Porosafariopas
jobs.description: Meillä on porot ja asiakkaat, mutta mistä saataisiin semmonen sanavalmis, positiivinen, pakkasta pelkäämätön ja asiakaspalveluhenkinen työkaveri? Poroa ei tarvitse osata puhua; me tutustutamme sinut näiden upeiden luontokappaleiden sieluelämään kyllä! Sen sijaan englanninkielen taito on pakollinen, sillä lähes kaikki asiakkaame ovat ulkomaalaisia. Toimenkuvaasi kuuluu porostelun lisäksi mm. isojen ryhmien hallintaa ja opastamista, vähän moottorikelkalla ajoa (tähän myös opastetaan ellei ole kokemusta) ja ihan vain tulistelua ja turinointia asiakkaiden kanssa. Siispä, jos tykkäät tehdä iltavuoropainotteista ulkotyötä sekä puuhastella ihmisten ja porojen kanssa, niin viihdyt meidän yhteisöllisessä porukassa ihan takuuvarmasti! Mikäli aloit tuntemaan poltetta pohjoiseen, ota ihmeessä yhteyttä! Kerromme sinulle lisää työtehtävistä, -kavereista ja henkilökunnan asunnoista. Oma auto on välttämätön.

jobs.title: Videnskabelig assistent til kvantitativ dataindsamling og statistisk analyse i uddannelsesvidenskab
jobs.description:
Ved Det humanistiske Fakultet, Syddansk Universitet i Odense er en fuldtidsstilling som videnskabelig assistent inden for uddannelsesvidenskab med særligt fokus på kvantitativ dataindsamling og statistisk analyse ledig til besættelse 1. januar 2027 og ét år frem.

Den videnskabelige assistent vil skulle arbejde på forskellige større og mindre forskningsprojekter, alle ledet af professor Ane Qvortrup. Fælles for projekterne er, at de undersøger danske og europæiske gymnasie- og erhvervsuddannelseselevers trivsel, selvforståelser og undervisningsoplevelser. Yderligere projekter kan komme til. 

De primære arbejdsopgaver vil bestå i kvantitativ dataindsamling og statistisk analysearbejde samt deltagelse i øvrige forskningsopgaver i relation til projekterne. Der søges en medarbejder, der har stærke kompetencer inden for kvantitative metoder, herunder i særdeleshed surveymetodik, og som har erfaring med uddannelsesvidenskabelig forskning. Ligeledes forventes gode kompetencer inden for mundtlig og skriftlig kommunikation.

Du kan læse mere om stillingen på vores hjemmeside

jobs.title: Night Receptionist for winter season 2026-2027
jobs.description: Kakslauttanen Arctic Resort is one of Finland's best-known and most talked about travel destinations. This family business, founded in 1974, is in Saariselkä, Lapland. Kakslauttanen hosts around 30,000 visitors each year, many of them from abroad. We are looking for skilled, experienced, and service-oriented night receptionist for the winter season 2026-2027. A Night Receptionist is responsible for assisting our guests and making sure they feel safe and well taken care of during the night. The work mainly involves helping guests with different requests, both by phone, messages and in person around the resort.Guest requests can be anything from bringing an extra blanket or helping with sauna instructions to opening a door if a guest has locked themselves out. You need to be ready to handle different situations and find solutions independently. The work requires a responsible, flexible and solution-oriented attitude, as you will be working independently during night shifts.The contract is seasonal, starting as soon as possible and ending at the end of March 2027. We provide full-time hours. The work schedule consists of 5 night shifts followed by 2 days off.The role will involve: * Assisting guests with their requests by phone, messages and in person * Helping guests with practical issues around the resort * Handling unexpected situations and finding solutions * Making sure guests feel safe and well taken care of during the night * Supporting other resort operations when neededDesired qualifications, skills, and experience: * Fluent in written and spoken English. Other languages are an advantage. * Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience * Previous experience in hotel reception work and night shifts is required * A valid driving license is required * Good experience and confidence in winter driving * Ability to work independently and make decisions * A responsible, proactive and solution-oriented attitude * Excellent customer service skillsWe have two receptions serving our guests during the winter season, in East Village and West Village. The Night Receptionist will work at our West Village reception, and the night receptionist takes care of our guests staying in both villages.The location of the resort is in the middle of beautiful nature. Here you also have time to enjoy nature and try different activities that you might not get to experience otherwise. We have a small gym for our staff, as well as opportunities to try cross-country skiing and other winter activities.You need to have a valid right to work in Finland, either through an EU/EEA citizenship or a valid residence permit that allows working in Finland. It is possible to rent an apartment through us, so joining our team is easy wherever you are coming from.In terms of employment, we follow the collective agreement of the tourism and restaurant industry (MaRa TES). The salary is based on the collective agreement and depends on your previous work experience and education.We review applications already during the application period, so we may contact suitable candidates before the application deadline.You can also read [https://kakslauttanen.teamtailor.com/posts]our blog to see how it's like to work at Kakslauttanen.

jobs.title: Kehityspäällikkö, mobiiliteknologiat | Erillisverkot / Espoo, Jyväskylä, Tampere, Kuopio, Turku, Oulu
jobs.description: Haluatko olla mukana kehittämässä yhteiskunnan kannalta kriittisiä viestintäratkaisuja ja tulevaisuuden mobiiliverkkoteknologioita?Haemme Ervejoukkoomme KEHITYSPÄÄLLIKKÖÄ mobiiliteknologioiden kehitykseen.Erillisverkot on valtion omistama yhtiö, jolla on erityinen tehtävä: me tarjoamme viranomaisille ja huoltovarmuustoimijoille turvalliset ja toimintavarmat ict-palvelut kaikissa olosuhteissa. Ne takaavat sen, että Suomi on maailman turvallisin maa nyt ja tulevaisuudessa. Tärkeä osa tehtävääsi on tunnistaa uusia teknologisia mahdollisuuksia ja viedä niitä kokeiluista ja innovaatioista kohti tuotannollisia ratkaisuja ja liiketoimintaa.**Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa**- mobiiliteknologioihin perustuvien palveluiden ja liiketoiminnan kehittäminen - mobiiliteknologioiden ja -ratkaisujen kehittäminen - 5G- ja 6G-teknologioiden sekä radioverkkoarkkitehtuurien kehityksen seuraaminen ja arviointi - osallistuminen teknologioiden ja ratkaisujen hankintaan - asiantuntijatehtävät tutkimus-, kehitys- ja innovaatiohankkeissa - kansallisiin ja kansainvälisiin hankkeisiin sekä asiantuntijaverkostoihin osallistuminen - uusien teknologioiden pilotointi ja soveltuvuuden arviointi - ratkaisujen vieminen innovaatiovaiheesta kohti palveluita ja liiketoimintaa - yhteistyö teknologiatoimittajien, kumppaneiden, asiakkaiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa. Hyödynnämme joustavaa hybridityömallia, jossa osa työstä on mahdollista tehdä etänä. Työ sisältää matkustamista kotimaassa ja ulkomailla.**Odotamme sinulta**- hyvää mobiiliteknologioiden ja -standardien tuntemusta - osaamista 5G- ja 6G-teknologioista, erityisesti radioverkkojen näkökulmasta - liiketoiminnan kehitysosaamista - tuotekehitys- tai teknologiakehitysosaamista - kokemusta projektien tai kehityskokonaisuuksien johtamisesta - valmiuksia toimia tutkimus-, kehitys- ja innovaatiohankkeissa - kykyä arvioida teknologioiden vaikutuksia palveluihin, arkkitehtuureihin ja liiketoimintaan - hyviä yhteistyö-, viestintä- ja verkostoitumistaitoja - sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa kansainvälisessä yhteistyössä. **Eduksi tehtävässä ovat**- ymmärrys mobiiliverkkojen suorituskyvystä, optimoinnista ja resilienssistä - kriittisen kommunikaation ratkaisujen tuntemus - turvallisuusviranomaisten toimintaympäristön tuntemus - kokemus kansainvälisestä TKI-toiminnasta - kokemus EU tutkimus- ja kehitysohjelmista, kuten Horizon Europe-, EDF- tai EDA-hankkeista - kokemus julkisista hankinnoista - kokemus teknologioiden tuotteistamisesta tai kaupallistamisesta - tietoliikenne- tai järjestelmäarkkitehtuurien tuntemus - kyberturvallisuuden huomioiminen teknologiaratkaisuissa - kokemus paikkatietojärjestelmien käytöstä. Vaikutamme työllämme Suomen turvallisuuteen. Vaativat ja monipuoliset tehtävät ainutlaatuisen asiakaskunnan ja teknologioiden parissa vaativat vastapainokseen erityisen hyvän työpaikan. Siksi meillä huolehditaan, että Ervejoukkomme voi hyvin ja virtaa riittää myös työpäivän jälkeen. Erveläisenä voit olla ylpeä työstäsi ja osaavista työkavereistasi. Arvomme yhteistyö, luottamus, kehitys ja vastuullisuus ovat työmme perusta.**Tarjoamme sinulle**- mahdollisuuden seurata uusimpien viestintäteknologioiden kehitystä läheltä ja vaikuttaa siihen, miten niitä hyödynnetään Suomessa kriittisessä viestinnässä - asiantuntevan työyhteisön, mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi sekä tehtävän, jossa teknologisilla valinnoilla on konkreettinen merkitys - työpaikan, jossa satsataan työntekijöiden hyvinvointiin; esimerkiksi vuonna 2026 erillisverkkolaiset saavat käyttää viikossa tunnin työaikaa liikuntaan - hybridityömahdollisuuden - hyvät työnteon puitteet ja mutkattoman työilmapiirin - ervenomaiset henkilöstöedut: lounasetu, virike-etu (käytettävissä myös hierontaan ja terveyspalveluihin), laaja työterveyshuolto, matkapuhelinetu ja laaja vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus - mahdollisuuden tulospalkkioon - kilpailukykyisen palkan, joka sijoittuu kokemuksestasi ja osaamistaustastasi riippuen 6000–6700 €/kk välille. Jokainen arvoihimme sitoutuva voi työskennellä turvallisuudentekijänä – iästä, kokemastaan sukupuolesta, koulutustaustasta, vakaumuksesta, seksuaalisesta suuntautumisesta, ulkonäöstä tai muusta ominaisuudesta riippumatta.**Teemme turvallisuuskriittistä** työtä yhteistyössä viranomaisten kanssa. jobs.title: OT/IT Engineer, Actiw
jobs.description: We are looking for an OT/IT Engineer to join Actiw and work on OT and IT solutions for international automation system projects.Actiw is one of the leading logistics innovators and solution providers, specialising in industrial storage and automated loading. Actiw Oy is part of the Joloda Hydraroll Ltd. group, and together we form the world's largest company dedicated to loading automation.Our Finnish offices are located in Pieksämäki and Jyväskylä. For over 30 years, we have been solving, optimising and automating material handling processes across various industries in collaboration with major global customers. We are fully committed to making our customers' loading processes easier by providing automated loading equipment, intelligent turnkey solutions and 24/7 services that improve safety and productivity.[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/a0d1f111-a9ab-4350-9b6c-16c352c6a37f/original.jpeg]Would you be our new OT/IT Engineer?As an OT/IT Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and implementing OT and IT solutions for our automation system projects. Your work will combine servers, networks, industrial IT and cybersecurity. You will be involved in different stages of our projects, from design and configuration to testing, documentation, commissioning and support. In practice, you will work with Linux servers, virtual machines, databases and industrial networks, as well as design and configure network solutions, switches, routers and firewalls.An important part of your role will be ensuring the cybersecurity of the systems we deliver. Your responsibilities will include managing access rights, secure remote connections and updates, as well as documenting technical solutions. You will work closely with our software, electrical and automation engineers and project teams, as well as our customers' IT, OT and cybersecurity specialists, turning their requirements into practical technical solutions. You will also support our sales team in reviewing customer OT/IT requirements during the RFQ phase and defining suitable technical solutions.In addition to customer projects, you will develop and maintain standardized and reusable OT/IT solutions, such as server and VM templates, reference network architectures and security configurations. You will also help ensure that our solutions comply with relevant OT/IT standards and regulations. As this is a new role at Actiw, you will also have the opportunity to shape the position and contribute to the development of our OT/IT expertise.This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Actiw. Your primary workplace will be in Jyväskylä or Pieksämäki, with a hybrid working model that allows you to work remotely a few days a week. The role may also include occasional travel within Finland and abroad.What are we looking for?You have a relevant educational background, for example in information technology, automation or electrical engineering. You have already gained relevant practical work experience in technical environments and are familiar with industrial IT and automation.We expect you to have experience with Linux server environments and a good understanding of computer networks and networking principles. Experience with virtualization, databases, network devices, firewalls and secure network solutions is also valued. A good understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals will help you succeed in the role. Knowledge of machine safety, industrial cybersecurity standards and relevant regulations is considered an advantage. You do not need to be an expert in every area from day one, but we expect you to have a solid technical foundation and a willingness to continuously develop your expertise.In addition to your technical skills, we value a systematic and solution-oriented approach and the ability to understand the bigger picture. You are able to turn customer requirements into practical technical solutions and clear documentation, and you enjoy working with experts from different fields as well as customers and partners.Why us?We offer you a responsible and interesting role where you will work on a variety of projects with well-known international customers. You will have the freedom to take ownership of your work while having the support of skilled colleagues around you. The role also offers excellent opportunities to develop professionally and broaden your expertise.Your work will have a tangible impact on the security, availability and quality of our systems. As this is a new position, you will have a genuine opportunity to shape your role and influence how our OT/IT solutions and operating practices are developed going forward.Our work community has a strong team spirit and a good sense of humour. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We want to provide our employees with the best possible working environment, including hybrid work and flexible working hours. You will also receive an annual sports benefit, occupational healthcare services and leisure-time insurance.Learn more about us: Actiw [https://www.joloda.com/en/about-us/actiw/]Are you interested?If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! jobs.title: Den selvejende institution Stefanshjemmet søger pr. 1/1 2027 en ergoterapeut til afdelingen Havglimt 2.  Arbejdstiden er 37 timer pr. uge.
jobs.description:
Den selvejende institution Stefanshjemmet søger pr. 1/1 2027 en ergoterapeut til afdelingen Havglimt 2. Arbejdstiden er 37 timer pr. uge.

Som ansat på Stefanshjemmet er det vigtigt for os, at du er fagligt stolt, engageret og har hjertet på rette sted og et menneskesyn der stemmer overens med Stefanshjemmets værdier. Dagligdagen byder på mange spændende faglige udfordringer og etiske dilemmaer. Havglimt 2. har en stabil medarbejdergruppe. Du får gode og dygtige kollegaer der hjælper hinanden, her er et godt arbejdsmiljø og højt humør mellem medarbejdere og beboere.

Stefanshjemmet er et bo- og beskæftigelsestilbud til mennesker med erhvervet hjerneskade og/eller svære fysiske handicap.

På afdelingen Havglimt 2. er der 10 beboere med erhvervet hjerneskade, men med forskellige udfordringer af fysisk, kognitiv og/eller kommunikativ karakter. Medarbejderne har en baggrund som fysioterapeut, SOSU-assistent, SOSU-hjælper, pædagog eller omsorgsmedarbejder og varetager pleje, omsorg, bostøtte og aktivitet for beboerne efter serviceloven.

På Stefanshjemmet værner vi om det tværfaglige miljø og har omkring 130 ansatte.

Arbejdet på afdelingerne tager udgangspunkt i beboernes behov og muligheder og vi samles af vores neuropædagogiske tilgang, en ressourceorienteret tilgang med KRAP som ramme. samt værdier og etik.

Alle medarbejdere indgår i arbejdet med plejeopgaver, bostøtte og aktiviteter for beboerne, og byder ind i de fælles opgaver med hver deres faglighed. Vi søger en dedikeret ergoterapeut, der har lyst til at indgå i såvel aktiviteterne som plejen og omsorgen for beboerne og i tilrettelæggelsen af denne.

Vi ønsker i afdelingen at gøre brug af ergoterapeutens viden om kroppens funktion, om udviklende og motivationsskabende aktiviteter i samværet med beboerne, såvel som viden om hjælpemidler og forflytninger.

Vi søger en ergoterapeut, der:

·        Er fagligt velfunderet og brænder for sit fag

·        Har blik for at anvende sin faglighed ind i en hverdag for beboerne, hvor ord som hverdagsrehabilitering, motivation og meningsfuld aktivitet vinder genklang

·        Har viden om eller vil sætte sig ind i anvendelse af hjælpemidler og forflytninger og evt. på sigt vil indtage rollen som forflytningsvejleder i afdelingen og i huset i samarbejde med andre terapeuter

·        Kan arbejde med beboernes mål i tæt samarbejde med øvrige fagpersoner

·        ser værdien i dokumentation og deling af viden i en tværfaglig kontekst

·        Evner at tage sig tid til nærvær med beboerne og påskønner livshistorierne

·        Er engageret og god til at se muligheder

·        Er udadvendt, opsøgende og initiativrig

Hvis du bliver ansat hos os, vil der blive udarbejdet et introduktionsprogram for dig som en del af din oplæring i huset.

Arbejdstiden er skiftende dag- og aftenvagter med arbejde hver 3 weekend.

På Stefanshjemmet er der desuden en boligforening med 44 boliger og et aktivitets- og samværstilbud.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til principperne om ny løn efter overenskomst med Ergoterapeutforeningen.

Stefanshjemmet har driftsoverenskomst med Aarhus Kommune. 

Ved yderligere spørgsmål kan du kontakte afdelingsleder Tina Rudebeck Holm, tlf. 4185 7871

Du kan indhente mere viden om Stefanshjemmet på vores hjemmeside: www.stefanshjemmet.dk

jobs.title: Directeur(trice) d'association d'accueil de groupes (H/F)
jobs.description: Suite au départ de son directeur le 30 septembre 2026, l'Association de Gestion du Centre d'Accueil Polyvalent (CAP) de Saint-Front (43) recrute en CDI à temps plein : un(e) directeur(trice) avec une prise de poste prévue le 1er février 2027.Son projet associatif s'appuie sur les valeurs de l'éducation populaire, de l'économie sociale et solidaire et du développement durable, avec un fort ancrage territorial. La gouvernance est assurée par un conseil d'administration composé de représentants associatifs (CEMEA Auvergne, Ligue de l'enseignement 43) et de la municipalité de Saint-Front.Le centre a récemment obtenu l'Écolabel, témoignant de son engagement dans la transition écologique.Description de la structure : www.cap-st-front.frMissions principales :Dans un contexte où l'Économie Sociale et Solidaire est sous tension, notamment pour les associations du secteur « Sport, Animation, Loisir et Lien social », la qualité de la gestion financière, la recherche proactive de nouvelles ressources et la vigilance sur les équilibres économiques constituent des priorités majeures du poste. Le(la) directeur(trice) exerce quatre grandes fonctions :1. Gestion financière, matérielle et administrative, et pilotage des équilibres économiques- Élaborer, suivre et analyser rigoureusement le budget annuel, gérer la trésorerie, contrôler les dépenses et recettes- Préparer les clôtures d'exercice en lien avec l'expert-comptable, assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la gouvernance.- Veiller à la maîtrise des coûts, anticiper les risques économiques et proposer des mesures correctives.- Superviser la gestion opérationnelle du site, l'entretien et la conformité des équipements.- Garantir la satisfaction des usagers par une démarche qualité continue.2. Conduite et mise en œuvre du projet d'action et de développement, et recherche proactive de ressources- Travailler en équipe avec les coordinateurs/trices et l'équipe permanente.- Développer les relations stratégiques et mobiliser les réseaux professionnels.- Animer la participation collective et la communication interne.- Rechercher de nouveaux publics, mener des actions de commercialisation et développer des activités génératrices de revenus.- Être pro-actif(ve) dans la recherche de nouvelles ressources (financements publics, privés, mécénat, appels à projets, diversification des activités), en cohérence avec le projet associatif et la nature de la structure d'accueil.3. Animation de l'équipe et gestion des ressources humaines- Manager de façon coopérative une équipe déjà en place (recrutement, formation, accompagnement, organisation du travail, évaluation).- Organiser les délégations et animer des temps collectifs pour donner du sens au travail- Veiller à la qualité de vie au travail, à la prévention des risques et à la gestion de la santé au travail.- Optimiser la gestion des ressources humaines en tenant compte des contraintes économiques.4. Évaluation et évolution du projet associatif- Analyser et partager les données d'activité avec la gouvernance, en intégrant systématiquement les impacts financiers.- Identifier et développer des partenariats locaux, en veillant à leur contribution à l'équilibre économique.- Préparer et suivre les conseils d'administration et assemblées générales.Profil recherché :Un expérience confirmée dans le tourisme social, les séjours collectifs de mineurs et la gestion d'équipement ainsi que la maitrise de la gestion financière et le management coopératif sont des compétences et des connaissances particulièrement attendues par l'employeur pour ce poste.Conditions :- Logement de fonction dans l'enceinte du centre (type F6) du fait d'un travail fréquent les week-end, vacances scolaires et les astreintes liées à la fonction.- Une première étape d'entretiens est prévue le 3 décembre 2026 sur place.

jobs.title: Job i Portugal med firmabolig - Kunderådgiver for Audi - Opstart den 3. december - Book en samtale i dag!
jobs.description:
Kundeservicerådgiver for Audi. Vi har opstart den 3. december med mulighed for firmabolig.

Er du klar til at tage springet og blive en del af en global digital organisation, der leverer support i verdensklasse?

Vi søger en kunderådgiver til en spændende rolle med Audi – en af Europas mest ikoniske bilproducenter. Stillingen er 100 % remote fra Portugal, og du bliver en nøglespiller i et internationalt team, der sikrer en ekstraordinær kunderejse for Audi’s brugere.

Hvad laver en Kundeservicerådgiver?

Som kundeservicerådgiver er du kundens direkte kontaktpunkt og hjælper med alt fra bilteknologi til digitale funktioner og serviceydelser. Du skaber en professionel oplevelse med struktur, empati og høj kvalitet i centrum.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Besvarelse af henvendelser via telefon, e-mail og chat

  • Fejlsøgning af tekniske problemer og vejledning i bilsystemer

  • Registrering af kundeinteraktioner i CRM-systemet

  • Opdatering på Audi’s produkter og politikker

  • Aktiv deltagelse i teamets deling af best practices

Dine kvalifikationer:

Vi leder efter dig, hvis du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk + har et minimum B2-niveau i engelsk

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice – gerne fra bilbranchen

  • Har teknisk flair og interesse for digitale løsninger

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt, løse problemer og skabe tillid

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav – vi opfordrer dig stadig til at søge!

Vi tilbyder:

  • Mulighed for firmabolig i Braga

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn plus bonusordning

  • Professionelle udviklingsmuligheder

  • Et samarbejdende og støttende arbejdsmiljø

  • Adgang til eksklusive rejsefordele og rabatter

  • Restaurantkort

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • 14 lønudbetalinger om året

Fordele ved at arbejde i en international virksomhed i Portugal

  • Udvidelse af dine faglige kompetencer gennem globalt samarbejde

  • Forbedring af kommunikation og salgsteknikker i et internationalt miljø

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for kundeservice, salg og rejsebranchen

  • Adgang til et netværk af internationale kolleger og brancheeksperter

  • Erfaring med moderne digitale værktøjer til kundehåndtering

Dette er en unik mulighed for at kombinere en stærk erhvervserfaring med en fleksibel arbejdsmodel.

Fordele ved at arbejde fra Portugal

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Høj livskvalitet – Portugal er kendt for sin afslappede livsstil, gode mad og venlige lokalbefolkning, hvilket skaber et positivt og behageligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Internationale karrieremuligheder – Arbejde i Portugal giver mulighed for at udvikle internationale færdigheder og samarbejde med kolleger fra forskellige nationaliteter, hvilket kan være en fordel for din fremtidige karriere.

  • God infrastruktur og moderne faciliteter – Portugal har en stærk digital infrastruktur, moderne kontorfaciliteter og gode transportmuligheder, hvilket sikrer en behagelig arbejdsdag.

  • Adgang til smukke strande og natur – Portugal tilbyder nem adgang til fantastiske strande, naturskønne områder og en rig kulturarv, som kan opleves både i fritiden og weekenderne.

  • Attraktiv skattepolitik for udlændinge – For internationale medarbejdere findes der skattefordele, der kan gøre det økonomisk fordelagtigt at arbejde i Portugal.

  • Voksende erhvervsliv og økonomi – Portugal har en blomstrende erhvervssektor, hvor flere internationale virksomheder etablerer sig, hvilket skaber gode jobmuligheder og karriereveje.

  • Stærkt netværk af expats og internationale virksomheder – Mange internationale virksomheder har kontorer i Portugal, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig i et globalt arbejdsmiljø.

Arbejdet i Portugal giver både professionel og personlig udvikling samt mulighed for at opleve en spændende livsstil med stor kulturel og økonomisk værdi.

Kontakt os på Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com eller Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com for at høre mere, vi vender retur indenfor 24 timer.

Du kan også bestille et opkald: Book et opkald her!

jobs.title: Bli vår nye mekaniker i Ålesund – frihet, faglige utfordringer og et rått team!
jobs.description:
Er du en dyktig mekaniker som brenner for at maskiner skal fungere 100 %, yte maksimalt og se skikkelige ut? Motiveres du av varierte dager, god tillit og friheten til å legge opp din egen hverdag slik at arbeidet flyter best mulig? Da vil du trives hos oss i Cramo.

 

Hos oss blir du ikke bare en som skrur, du får det reelle ansvaret for at utleieparken i Ålesund spiller på lag. Verkstedet og maskinparken blir ditt stolte ansvarsområde, hvor du får styre prosessene, planlegge kapasiteten og ta de faglige avgjørelsene som utgjør en forskjell. Du får en nøkkelrolle med stor handlingsfrihet, samtidig som du blir en del av et uformelt og faglig sterkt team som deler erfaringer og mener at god humor er like viktig som godt håndverk.

 

Hva tilbyr vi deg?

Vi vet at en avdeling kun fungerer bra når folk trives. Derfor legger vi alt til rette for en forutsigbar og god hverdag med lavt stressnivå, selv når det koker litt ekstra.

 

  • Stor tillit og faglig eierskap: Du får styre hverdagen din i stor grad selv og ta avgjørelser som påvirker driften direkte.
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø å sparre med: Du står aldri alene! Teamet i Ålesund, sammen med erfarne mekanikere i resten av regionen, samarbeider tett og deler gladelig av sin erfaring.
  • Gode betingelser: Konkurransedyktig lønn, attraktiv bonusordning og solid pensjons- og forsikringspakke.
  • Balanse og trivsel: Vi har fokus på trivsel og at du har det bra både på og utenfor jobb. Du får støtte til trening og én betalt frivillighetsdag i året.
  • Uformell kultur: En «klart vi kan»-holdning med rom for god humor og høyt under taket.

 

Hva innebærer rollen hos oss?

Som mekaniker hos Cramo i Ålesund tar du styringen over arbeidshverdagen. Du sørger for at maskinene våre er funksjonelle, godt vedlikeholdt og fremstår visuelt flotte for kundene våre.

 

Dine viktigste oppgaver vil være:

  • Helhetlig eierskap til maskinparken: Feilsøking, service, reparasjoner og klargjøring før, under og etter utleie.
  • Styre kapasitet og innkjøp: Du vurderer arbeidsmengden fortløpende. Ved topper, servicer eller årskontroller har du mandat til å koordinere med eksterne leverandører/mekanikere.
  • Prosess- og kostnadskontroll: Du styrer hele reparasjonsløpet fra feilsøking til registrering og kostnadsføring på serviceordre, slik at drift kan fakturere reelle reparasjonskostnader videre.
  • Verksteddrift: Holde orden i delebestillinger, optimalisere verksteddriften og redusere antall maskiner som står «nede».
  • Utrykninger og feltoppdrag: Noen dager jobber du på verkstedet, andre dager drar du ut til kunden og blir helten som løser utfordringene på stedet.

 

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi leter ikke etter en superhelt som kan alt fra dag en, men etter deg som brenner for mekaniker faget, liker å ha oversikt og har god teknisk forstand. Du stolt av jobben du gjør, enten du løser en kompleks feilkode eller sørger for at en maskin ser skinnende ny ut for neste kunde.

 

Det er ideelt om du har:

  • Fagbrev innen anleggs-, landbruks- eller industrimekanikk, elektro (Gr. L) eller et annet relevant mekanisk fag.
  • …men har du lang, praktisk erfaring og en "skru-hjerne" som løser det meste? Søk likevel! Hos oss veier reell kompetanse, faglig engasjement og rett innstilling veldig høyt.
  • Førerkort klasse B (har du BE eller truckførerbevis er det en fin bonus. Har du det ikke, så finner vi ut av det sammen).

  • Grunnleggende digitale ferdigheter og gode norskkunnskaper.

     

Du er en vi passe sammen med dersom du:

  • Motiveres av tillit og frihet under ansvar, og liker å ha kontroll på egne prosjekter og kostnader.
  • Trives med at det koker litt ekstra i ny og ne, men mestrer kunsten å holde hodet kaldt slik at det aldri oppleves som uoversiktlig stress.
  • Er en utpreget lagspiller som bryr seg om kollegene sine, sprer god stemning i kaffepausene og skaper en trygg, inkluderende arbeidsplass.

 

Klar for nye utfordringer?

Send oss en søknad eller ta kontakt for en uforpliktende prat om rollen! Vi gleder oss til å bli kjent med deg.

 

 

 

 

For mer informasjon eller spørsmål, kontakt oss på:

Mail: Richard.taylor@randstad.noMobil: 982 95 163

For å søke:Registrer din CV online på www.randstad.no og søk på denne stillingen.

  • Søknadsfrist - Senest 16.11.26. (Ansettelse kan bli gjort før frist)

Alle søkere vil få svar og blir kontaktet.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Cramo er et av Norges ledende utleieselskaper innen maskiner, utstyr og modulbygg for bygg, anlegg, industri og offentlig sektor. Vi har over 30 avdelinger, mer enn 300 ansatte og er sertifisert innen kvalitet, miljø og arbeidsmiljø (ISO 9001, 14001 og 45001).

Siden 2020 har Cramo vært en del av Boels Rental, en av Europas største og mest fremtidsrettede 

aktører innen utleiebransjen. Dette gir oss et solid apparat i ryggen og gode forutsetninger for videre utvikling.

I vår avdeling jobber vi målrettet for å levere de beste løsningene i markedet, med høy aktivitet, tett samarbeid med både små og store kunder, og et fremoverlent arbeidsmiljø preget av kontinuerlig utvikling og varierte arbeidsoppgaver.

jobs.title: HR Country Manager Denmark
jobs.description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.   As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.  About the job As HR Country Manager, you will be supporting Alfa Laval's Scaling for Future direction, with a focus on Denmark, with 2000 employees and five Danish legal entities. The role in this form is newly established, giving you a fantastic opportunity to influence the position and make it your own!  The position supports several types of organizations in Denmark and Scandinavia, such as sales companies, factories, shared services, business units, and product groups. The key priority will be to ensure HR alignment across the legal entities and compliance with Danish legislation and collective agreements. You will contribute to harmonizing people policies and practices and as a trusted partner, you will support and inspire management by proactively driving organizational, leadership, and competence development.  You will act as:     HR Country Manager for Denmark, ensuring alignment, compliance, and consistent HR practices across all five legal entities across four sites - Søborg, Kolding, Aalborg and Nakskov.     HR Representative in the Danish Country Council, coordinating national HR topics and providing a consolidated HR view to business leaders in the country council     HR Business Partner for Søborg Site Services and the HR Shared Services Scandinavia organization.     Local HR responsibility for the Søborg site, including Site Management, the Works Council, the Work Environment Council, and the Crisis Management Team.     The one responsible for overall country-level approach to unions, including ensuring alignment in union relationships, works council cooperation and collective agreement governance and also provide guidance together with HR Shared Services on employee relations areas.  Operational responsibilities:    Plan and drive national HR focus areas for the five Danish entities aligned with the business strategy and People Strategy.     Develop and implement people policies, processes, routines, guidelines, tools and analytics.     Ensure country-wide consistency for benefits frameworks, allowances, principles, policies.     Coordinate the salary budget and review process in Denmark together with the Employee Relations team in HR Shared Services     Drive, support and inspire management in organizational, leadership, and competence development.     Coordinate local HR activities at the Søborg site, including collaboration with employee representatives and relevant councils.  Travel is part of the job, mainly to our various sites in Denmark, but you will also have a few travel days a year within Europe. You will be part of the Danish Country Council management team as well as part of the Søborg Site Management team. You report to Per Lund Hansen, a manager who will give you freedom and mandate to perform at your best. You will also have a dotted line to our VP Total Rewards and HR Shared Services, Gabriella Nagy Olofsson.  Who you are You are an experienced and confident HR professional, who is ready to take on the role as a trusted sparring partner for managers and leaders. You bring a genuine interest in understanding the business and getting to know our people. To succeed we see you as a strong communicator able to create engagement, participation, and clarity. You are people-oriented and build good solid relationships and have the know-how in leading through others. You make decisions with overall perspective and consider the needs of the entire organization.  Requirements:     Solid experience from a similar role within a larger international matrix organization and a strong background in country-level HR governance.     In-depth knowledge of Danish labour law, industrial relations, negotiations and collective agreements.     Experience in leading and coordinating change work, developing and implementing HR processes, routines, and guidelines.     Good ability to work in HR systems     Excellent communication skills in Danish and English and the ability to formulate clear and well-structured routines, guidelines, and strategic documents.     Completed university education in HR of at least 180 ECTS credits, or an equivalent education deemed relevant by the employer.     Driving license. We do not accept applications via email, due to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Please send your application no later than November 18, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long!  While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing close to our office in Søborg, Denmark. We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.  As part of Alfa Laval's commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role, and alcohol and drug testing is applied during the pre‑employment process.  #LI-CL1

jobs.title: Kahvilapäällikkö- Café Il Mondo, Goodman, Hämeenlinna
jobs.description: Oletko intohimoinen asiakaspalvelun ammattilainen ja innostava tiiminvetäjä? Haluatko olla mukana luomassa lämminhenkistä kahvilakokemusta keskellä Hämeenlinnan vilkkainta kauppakeskusta? Café il Mondo etsii nyt **kahvilapäällikköä** Goodmaniin!**Mitä pääset tekemään?**Kahvilapäällikkönä vastaat Café il Mondon päivittäisestä toiminnasta, asiakaskokemuksesta ja henkilöstön johtamisesta. Huolehdit siitä, että kahvilamme tunnelma, palvelu ja tuotteet ylittävät asiakkaiden odotukset joka päivä.Työtehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa:- kahvilan päivittäisen toiminnan johtaminen - henkilöstön ohjaaminen, motivointi ja työvuorosuunnittelu - asiakaskokemuksen kehittäminen ja laadun varmistaminen - myynnin seuranta ja tavoitteellinen toiminnan kehittäminen - tilausten, omavalvonnan ja kahvilan sujuvan arjen hallinta - osallistuminen myös käytännön asiakaspalvelutyöhön **Mitä toivomme sinulta?**Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on positiivinen ja aktiivinen ote työhön sekä kyky luoda hyvä henki ympärilleen.Toivomme sinulta:- kokemusta kahvila-, ravintola- tai palvelualalta - aiempaa esihenkilö- tai tiiminvetokokemusta - energistä ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta - vahvoja asiakaspalvelu- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja - kykyä toimia tehokkaasti myös kiireessä - hygieniapassia **Mitä tarjoamme?**Tarjoamme sinulle:- vastuullisen ja monipuolisen työn tunnetussa kahvilassa - mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa ja kehittää toimintaa - energisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön - perehdytyksen sekä tuen onnistumiseesi - kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen - työympäristön kauppakeskus Goodmanin keskeisellä paikalla Työ on kokoaikainen ja alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.**Kiinnostuitko?**Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si sähköpostilla tekes@cafeilmondo.fi mahdollisimman pian kuitenkin tiistaihin 16.11.2026. mennessä. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.**Tule rakentamaan Café il Mondon ainutlaatuista kahvilatunnelmaa Hämeenlinnan sydämeen**
